title: Senior Security Engineer (m/f/d)
description: <p><strong>Mission Brief</strong>&nbsp;</p> <p>You are the guardian and the challenger of our security posture. At Isar Aerospace, the systems that build our rockets and the ground systems that launch them are mission critical, and protecting them takes more than good design. It takes someone who will attack their own work to be sure it holds.&nbsp;</p> <p>We are looking for a deeply hands-on Senior Security Engineer. You live in the consoles, the rule sets and the code. title: Senior Business Development Manager - New Business, UK & Europe
description: About GeminiSense GeminiSense is a collaboration between Bold Communications Ltd and Innovative Business Software (IBS) , two established software businesses within the Valsoft Corporation portfolio. The collaboration brings together the technology, experience and deep industry expertise of both organisations to deliver a next-generation, event-driven monitoring platform for the security and monitoring industry. GeminiSense enables organisations to monitor, identify and respond to critical events in real time, bringing together alarm and incident management, CCTV and video monitoring, lone-worker protection, IoT and sensor monitoring, communications, task management and third-party integrations within a powerful, unified monitoring environment. The platform is designed for demanding operational environments including Alarm Receiving Centres (ARCs), security monitoring centres, airports, corporate and industrial organisations, facilities management, manufacturing, local government, retail and other security-critical operations. Backed by two Valsoft-owned software companies, GeminiSense combines deep industry knowledge with the resources and ambition to build a significant presence across the UK and European markets. We are now looking for an exceptional Senior Business Development Manager – New Business to play a key role in accelerating that growth. The Opportunity This is a new-business hunter role. We are looking for an ambitious, commercially aggressive and highly proactive Senior Business Development Manager who thrives on creating opportunities, opening doors and closing new business. This is not an account-management role , nor is it a position for someone who expects to rely on a steady flow of inbound leads. You will be responsible for building your own pipeline, identifying and targeting high-value prospective customers, engaging senior decision-makers and converting opportunities into new customers and recurring revenue. You will own the complete sales process from initial prospecting and discovery through product demonstration, proposal development, commercial negotiation and contract signature. You will have significant autonomy to develop the UK and European territory and will be expected to bring the energy, persistence and commercial discipline required to build a substantial new-business pipeline. Your objective is simple: create pipeline, win new logos and generate new recurring revenue. Key Responsibilities Own new-business development across the UK and European markets. Develop and execute a clear territory, vertical-market and target-account strategy. Identify and penetrate high-value prospective customers across GeminiSense’s target markets. Build and maintain a substantial qualified new-business pipeline. Generate your own opportunities through proactive outbound prospecting, direct outreach, networking, referrals, partners, industry events and targeted account development. Conduct consistent, high-quality prospecting into target organisations and named strategic accounts. Identify multiple routes into target organisations and develop relationships with key stakeholders and influencers. Engage confidently with senior decision-makers including CEOs, Managing Directors, Operations Directors, Security Directors, Control Room Managers, IT leaders and other relevant executives. Conduct effective discovery to understand each prospect’s operational, security, technical and commercial challenges. Translate customer requirements into compelling GeminiSense solutions with clearly defined operational and commercial benefits. Position and sell the broader GeminiSense platform across alarm and incident management, CCTV/video monitoring, lone-worker protection, IoT and sensor monitoring, communications, workflow and associated monitoring applications. Deliver compelling presentations, discovery sessions and product demonstrations, working with technical and product specialists where appropriate. Develop strong commercial proposals, business cases and ROI justifications. Own opportunities throughout the complete sales cycle, from initial contact through to contract signature. Maintain momentum throughout the sales process and proactively identify and overcome obstacles to closing. Develop relationships across multiple stakeholders within prospective customers to maximise the probability of successful conversion. Negotiate pricing, commercial terms and contracts. Consistently achieve or exceed agreed new ARR and revenue targets. Maintain a disciplined, accurate and appropriately weighted sales pipeline. Deliver reliable monthly and quarterly sales forecasts. Develop strategic relationships with technology partners, integrators and other organisations capable of generating new opportunities. Represent GeminiSense at relevant exhibitions, conferences, customer meetings and industry events throughout the UK and Europe. Monitor competitors, market developments and emerging opportunities across the security and monitoring technology markets. Provide structured customer and market feedback to Product, Marketing and Leadership teams. Work closely with Marketing to develop targeted campaigns while remaining personally accountable for pipeline creation and new customer acquisition. What We’re Looking For We are looking for a proven new-business salesperson , not simply someone with sales experience. The successful candidate will have: A demonstrable track record of winning new B2B customers and exceeding sales targets . Strong evidence of personally generating significant sales pipeline rather than relying predominantly on marketing-generated or inbound leads. Experience selling complex B2B software, SaaS or technology solutions. A history of successfully developing new territories, opening strategic accounts and winning new logos. raw.title: Senior Business Development Manager - New Business, UK & Europe
raw.description:
About GeminiSense

GeminiSense is a collaboration between Bold Communications Ltd and Innovative Business Software (IBS), two established software businesses within the Valsoft Corporation portfolio.

The collaboration brings together the technology, experience and deep industry expertise of both organisations to deliver a next-generation, event-driven monitoring platform for the security and monitoring industry.

GeminiSense enables organisations to monitor, identify and respond to critical events in real time, bringing together alarm and incident management, CCTV and video monitoring, lone-worker protection, IoT and sensor monitoring, communications, task management and third-party integrations within a powerful, unified monitoring environment.

The platform is designed for demanding operational environments including Alarm Receiving Centres (ARCs), security monitoring centres, airports, corporate and industrial organisations, facilities management, manufacturing, local government, retail and other security-critical operations.

Backed by two Valsoft-owned software companies, GeminiSense combines deep industry knowledge with the resources and ambition to build a significant presence across the UK and European markets.

We are now looking for an exceptional Senior Business Development Manager – New Business to play a key role in accelerating that growth.

The Opportunity

This is a new-business hunter role.

We are looking for an ambitious, commercially aggressive and highly proactive Senior Business Development Manager who thrives on creating opportunities, opening doors and closing new business.

This is not an account-management role, nor is it a position for someone who expects to rely on a steady flow of inbound leads.

You will be responsible for building your own pipeline, identifying and targeting high-value prospective customers, engaging senior decision-makers and converting opportunities into new customers and recurring revenue.

You will own the complete sales process from initial prospecting and discovery through product demonstration, proposal development, commercial negotiation and contract signature.

You will have significant autonomy to develop the UK and European territory and will be expected to bring the energy, persistence and commercial discipline required to build a substantial new-business pipeline.

Your objective is simple: create pipeline, win new logos and generate new recurring revenue.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own new-business development across the UK and European markets.
  • Develop and execute a clear territory, vertical-market and target-account strategy.
  • Identify and penetrate high-value prospective customers across GeminiSense’s target markets.
  • Build and maintain a substantial qualified new-business pipeline.
  • Generate your own opportunities through proactive outbound prospecting, direct outreach, networking, referrals, partners, industry events and targeted account development.
  • Conduct consistent, high-quality prospecting into target organisations and named strategic accounts.
  • Identify multiple routes into target organisations and develop relationships with key stakeholders and influencers.
  • Engage confidently with senior decision-makers including CEOs, Managing Directors, Operations Directors, Security Directors, Control Room Managers, IT leaders and other relevant executives.
  • Conduct effective discovery to understand each prospect’s operational, security, technical and commercial challenges.
  • Translate customer requirements into compelling GeminiSense solutions with clearly defined operational and commercial benefits.
  • Position and sell the broader GeminiSense platform across alarm and incident management, CCTV/video monitoring, lone-worker protection, IoT and sensor monitoring, communications, workflow and associated monitoring applications.
  • Deliver compelling presentations, discovery sessions and product demonstrations, working with technical and product specialists where appropriate.
  • Develop strong commercial proposals, business cases and ROI justifications.
  • Own opportunities throughout the complete sales cycle, from initial contact through to contract signature.
  • Maintain momentum throughout the sales process and proactively identify and overcome obstacles to closing.
  • Develop relationships across multiple stakeholders within prospective customers to maximise the probability of successful conversion.
  • Negotiate pricing, commercial terms and contracts.
  • Consistently achieve or exceed agreed new ARR and revenue targets.
  • Maintain a disciplined, accurate and appropriately weighted sales pipeline.
  • Deliver reliable monthly and quarterly sales forecasts.
  • Develop strategic relationships with technology partners, integrators and other organisations capable of generating new opportunities.
  • Represent GeminiSense at relevant exhibitions, conferences, customer meetings and industry events throughout the UK and Europe.
  • Monitor competitors, market developments and emerging opportunities across the security and monitoring technology markets.
  • Provide structured customer and market feedback to Product, Marketing and Leadership teams.
  • Work closely with Marketing to develop targeted campaigns while remaining personally accountable for pipeline creation and new customer acquisition.

What We’re Looking For

We are looking for a proven new-business salesperson, not simply someone with sales experience.

The successful candidate will have:

  • A demonstrable track record of winning new B2B customers and exceeding sales targets.
  • Strong evidence of personally generating significant sales pipeline rather than relying predominantly on marketing-generated or inbound leads.
  • Experience selling complex B2B software, SaaS or technology solutions.
  • A history of successfully developing new territories, opening strategic accounts and winning new logos.
  • The confidence and ability to prospect consistently at senior and executive levels.
  • Excellent discovery and consultative selling capabilities.
  • Strong commercial instincts combined with a relentless focus on progressing and closing opportunities.
  • Experience managing complex, multi-stakeholder B2B sales cycles.
  • Confidence negotiating significant commercial agreements.
  • The ability to translate sophisticated technical capabilities into clear commercial and operational benefits.
  • Strong presentation, communication and negotiation skills.
  • Excellent pipeline-management and forecasting discipline.
  • High levels of personal accountability, resilience and self-motivation.
  • The ability to operate independently and effectively within a remote environment.
  • A willingness to travel throughout the UK and Europe as required.

Highly Desirable Industry Experience

Candidates with a strong track record within one or more of the following markets will be particularly attractive:

Security Technology | Alarm Monitoring | Alarm Receiving Centres (ARCs) | Security Monitoring Centres | CCTV & Video Management | PSIM | Lone-Worker Solutions | Manned Guarding Technology | IoT & Sensor Monitoring | Access Control | Smart Buildings | Critical Event Management | Incident Management Software | Physical Security Software

An established network of contacts within the security, monitoring, facilities-management or related technology sectors would be a significant advantage.

Experience selling into large enterprise customers and complex operational environments would also be highly desirable.

Additional European language skills and previous experience selling across multiple European territories would be advantageous.

The Person

We are looking for someone who is:

Competitive. Persistent. Resilient. Commercial. Accountable. Driven.

You should genuinely enjoy the challenge of opening doors that are initially closed.

An unanswered email, unsuccessful call or initial rejection should not end your pursuit of an attractive account. You will identify another stakeholder, find another route into the organisation and continue developing the opportunity.

You will be comfortable creating opportunities from a relatively cold territory and will not require a constant stream of marketing-generated leads to remain productive.

You will be highly organised and disciplined in how you manage your territory, pipeline and opportunities, while maintaining the urgency required to drive deals forward.

You will combine the persistence and determination of a true new-business hunter with the professionalism, credibility and consultative skills required to sell sophisticated technology into large and potentially mission-critical organisations.

Above all, you will have a demonstrable history of turning prospecting activity into pipeline and pipeline into revenue.

How Success Will Be Measured

This is a performance-driven sales position with clear accountability for results.

Key performance measures will include:

  • New Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR) / revenue generated
  • New customers and new logos won
  • Qualified new-business pipeline created
  • Pipeline coverage against sales target
  • Target-account penetration
  • Outbound prospecting effectiveness
  • Qualified meetings and demonstrations generated
  • Opportunity creation and conversion
  • Sales-cycle progression
  • Win rates
  • Forecast accuracy
  • Achievement against quarterly and annual sales targets

The successful candidate will be expected to maintain sufficient qualified pipeline coverage to support consistent achievement of their revenue target.

Compensation

We want to attract an exceptional salesperson and recognise that compensation needs to reflect the calibre, experience and proven performance of the successful individual.

Base salary will therefore be dependent on the candidate’s experience, industry knowledge and, most importantly, their proven track record of winning new business and consistently delivering against sales targets.

In addition to base salary, the position will include a highly competitive, uncapped commission plan directly linked to new-business performance.

The commission structure will reward overachievement, with accelerators above 100% of target, ensuring that exceptional sales performance results in exceptional earnings.

There will be no cap on earning potential for a salesperson who consistently exceeds their targets.

Why GeminiSense?

This is an opportunity to join GeminiSense at an exciting stage of its development and play a significant role in building its presence across the UK and Europe.

GeminiSense combines the expertise and capabilities of Bold Communications Ltd and Innovative Business Software A/S, both part of the Valsoft Corporation portfolio.

This provides the successful candidate with the opportunity to take an innovative technology platform to market while benefiting from the experience, industry knowledge and backing of established software businesses.

This is not about simply inheriting and managing a mature sales territory.

You will have the opportunity to build one.

You will identify target markets, penetrate strategic accounts, establish new relationships, win new customers and help establish GeminiSense as a significant player within the UK and European security and monitoring technology markets.

For the right salesperson, this role offers significant autonomy, market opportunity and uncapped earning potential, alongside the opportunity to make a highly visible contribution to the growth and success of GeminiSense.

If you’re a proven new-business hunter who enjoys opening doors, creating opportunities, winning new customers and closing deals, we want to hear from you.

title: Werkstudent Data QA & Algorithm Benchmarking (m/w/d)
description: Deine Mission syte benutzt komplexe Algorithmen, die auf Basis von 3D-Punktwolken und 3D-Modellen Gebäudemetriken ausrechnen. Typische Beispiele für relevante Metriken sind Geschossfläche, Anzahl Geschosse, Volumen und Gebäudehöhen. Um schnelle Entwicklungszyklen zu gewährleisten, und Änderungen an den Algorithmen auf Knopfdruck quantitativ und automatisiert bewerten zu können, ist syte auf hochwertige QA-Daten angewiesen. Um diesen Datensatz systematisch auszubauen und zu härten und damit die Grundlage, auf der unsere Algorithmen gemessen werden , zu entwickeln, suchen wir dich als Werkstudent Data QA & Algorithm Benchmarking (m/w/d) zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt in Münster. Deine Aufgaben Ground Truth Audit: Du evaluierst die Korrektheit bestehender Testdaten und ermittelst hierfür neue Metriken, die wir zur Evaluation unserer Algorithmen verwenden können. Edge Cases jagen: Du ermittelst neue Testdaten für schwierige Gebäude (z.B. komplexe Dachformen, Bäume über den Dächern) und integrierst diese in den Gesamtdatensatz. Data Sourcing: Du ermittelst potenzielle Quellen für neue Testdatensätze und integrierst diese möglichst automatisiert. Benchmarking & Insights: Du führst unsere Benchmarking-Pipelines aus, um sowohl die Algorithmen als auch die Qualität der Daten quantitativ zu bewerten. Die Ergebnisse dieser Analysen visualisierst und kommunizierst du verständlich, sodass sich daraus Handlungsempfehlungen ableiten. Pipeline Engineering: Du implementierst und testest Verbesserungen in den Benchmarking-Pipelines und den Parametern der Algorithmen. Dein Profil Dein Studium: Du studierst in einem höheren Bachelorsemester oder ersten Mastersemester (Geo-/Wirtschafts-)Informatik oder hast einen Schwerpunkt in Data Science/Statistik. Du hast auch einen gültigen Immatrikulationsnachweis. Analytische Fähigkeiten: Du arbeitest dich gerne tief in Daten ein und begeisterst dich für die statistische Analyse der Daten. Neugierde für die komplexe Daten: Dir gefällt die Arbeit an und das Nachvollziehen von komplexeren Algorithmen in einer anspruchsvollen Domäne. title: Senior Software Engineer (m/w/d) | Fullstack für KI-Produkte
description: Über uns Wie bleibt ein RAG-System präzise, wenn aus tausend Dokumenten hunderttausend werden? Wie orchestriert man mehrere Modellanbieter sauber hinter einer Oberfläche? Während anderswo noch Prototypen gezeigt werden, arbeiten unsere Kunden längst damit - mit ihren Daten, ihren Regeln, gehostet in Deutschland. Als Senior Engineer verantwortest du Kernfunktionen und Architektur unserer Plattform, vom Retrieval bis ins Frontend - und du entwickelst sie so, wie wir arbeiten: AI-gestützt, mit Coding-Agents als Teil des Werkzeugkastens und mit echtem Gestaltungsspielraum für deine Ideen. Du suchst eine Rolle, in der technische Tiefe und Produktverantwortung zusammenkommen? Dann sollten wir uns kennenlernen! Das gibt es zu tun Architektur & Umsetzung Du entwirfst und skalierst verteilte Systeme und Microservices - immer mit Blick auf Wartbarkeit, Stabilität und die Frage, was in zwei Jahren noch trägt. KI-Features bauen, die im Alltag halten Du entwickelst die Kernfunktionen unserer Plattform - von RAG-basierten Wissensdatenbanken über KI-Apps für einzelne Fachbereiche bis zu Voice-, Übersetzungs- und Analytics-Funktionen. Full-Stack liefern Du entwickelst performante APIs, modellierst Daten und Datenbanken und setzt moderne Oberflächen im Frontend um - vom Retrieval bis zur Benutzeroberfläche. Daten, Sicherheit & Mandantenfähigkeit Du modellierst Daten für Multi-Tenancy und rollenbasierte Berechtigungen - so, dass niemand über die KI Zugriff auf etwas bekommt, das er nicht sehen darf. Verschlüsselung, Datenminimierung und Auditierbarkeit denkst du von Anfang an mit. Betrieb & Observability mitdenken Du sorgst dafür, dass Qualität, Kosten und Verhalten der KI-Features im Betrieb sichtbar bleiben - mit Evaluations, Monitoring und klaren Guardrails, damit die Plattform auch bei wachsender Nutzung stabil und effizient läuft. Komplexität beherrschen Du entwickelst bestehende Systeme weiter, schaffst klare Strukturen und reduzierst technische Schulden dort, wo sie langfristig teuer werden und lässt sie stehen, wo sie es nicht sind. AI-gestützt entwickeln – und den Standard dafür setzen Du arbeitest selbstverständlich mit Coding-Assistenten und Agenten, holst mehr aus ihnen heraus als Autocomplete und weißt genau, wo ihre Grenzen liegen. Neue Tools und Workflows testest du früh, bewertest sie ehrlich und etablierst im Team, wie wir sie sinnvoll einsetzen. Team & Produkt weiterbringen Du arbeitest eng mit Product Owner, UX und unseren Consultants zusammen, übersetzt echte Kunden-Use-Cases in Technik, machst technische Entscheidungen transparent und bringst unsere Junior Developer durch Code Reviews und Mentoring fachlich weiter. Das bringst Du mit Mindestens 5 Jahre Erfahrung in der Entwicklung komplexer Softwaresysteme, idealerweise im KI- bzw. SaaS/Cloud-Umfeld Sehr gute TypeScript-Kenntnisse, Erfahrung mit Node.js und idealerweise Frameworks wie NestJS Sehr gute Kenntnisse in Softwarearchitektur für verteilte Systeme - Microservices, API-Design, Skalierung Erfahrung im Frontend, z. B. mit Vue.js, sowie ein gutes Verständnis für Full-Stack-Zusammenhänge Fundierte Kenntnisse im Umgang mit Datenbanken (z. B. PostgreSQL), Datenmodellierung und Performance-Optimierung Erfahrung mit Cloud-Plattformen (z. B. AWS), Docker und dem Betrieb von SaaS-Anwendungen AI-gestütztes Entwickeln ist für dich Alltag: Du arbeitest routiniert mit Coding-Assistenten und -Agenten (z. B. Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot), kennst ihre Grenzen und prüfst generierten Code kritisch, statt ihm zu vertrauen Du bist nah am Puls der Entwicklung: Du probierst neue Tools, Modelle und Workflows aktiv aus und bringst die guten ins Team - Erfahrung mit agentischen Setups (z. B. Coding-Agents in der Cloud, MCP-Integrationen, automatisierte Reviews) ist ein starkes Plus Tieferes Verständnis moderner AI-/LLM-Konzepte wie RAG, Function Calling, Embeddings oder Agenten Clean Code, Testing und Code Reviews sind für dich selbstverständlich und du bringst Junior Developers durch Reviews und Mentoring gern fachlich weiter Du triffst technische Entscheidungen und kannst sie nachvollziehbar vertreten - auf Deutsch und auf Englisch Erfahrung mit DSGVO, ISO 27001 oder dem EU AI Act sind ein Plus Was uns wichtig ist Frameworks kann man lernen. Was uns viel wichtiger ist: Verantwortung übernehmen, das Produkt mitdenken, Anforderungen konstruktiv hinterfragen und technische Entscheidungen treffen, die man auch in zwei Jahren noch begründen kann - pragmatisch abgewogen zwischen Perfektion und Geschwindigkeit. Konkret heißt das: Du entwirfst morgens die Architektur für ein neues Feature, reviewst mittags Pull Requests, entwickelst nachmittags selbst und bringst dabei unser Team fachlich weiter. Wer lieber Tickets abarbeitet und auf Anforderungen wartet, wird bei uns nicht glücklich. Das bekommst Du Start & Welcoming so wie du es verdienst! Ein strukturiertes Onboarding mit echten Ansprechpersonen - damit du vom ersten Tag an durchstartest. Remote Work Homeoffice innerhalb von Deutschland oder Arbeiten in unserem modernen Büro in Offenburg? Arbeite so, wie es für dich am besten passt. AI-first arbeiten, statt darüber zu reden Lizenzen für Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot & Co. stellen wir. Neue Tools und Modelle darfst du ausprobieren, statt sie zu beantragen – und deine Erkenntnisse verändern, wie das ganze Team arbeitet. Kurze Wege, keine Entscheidungsgremien Architekturentscheidungen trifft das Team, das sie später auch betreibt. Deine Ideen landen im Produkt, nicht in einem Backlog-Archiv. Betriebliche Altersvorsorge mit 20 % Arbeitgeberzuschuss - deutlich über dem gesetzlichen Standard. Du entscheidest ob Hansefit -Mitgliedschaft oder 50 € monatlich per Spendit Card - dein Benefit, deine Wahl. Urlaub , der mit dir wächst: 30 Tage Jahresurlaub + dazu Weihnachten und Silvester frei - und mit steigender Betriebszugehörigkeit kommen weitere Tage dazu. Jobticket oder JobRad - wir machen deinen Weg ins Office einfacher und grüner. Feiern gehört dazu - Quarterly Allhands Events, Sommerfest, Weihnachtsfeier oder einfach so - wir wissen, wie man Korken knallen lässt. Ein Team, das wirklich zählt. Flache Hierarchien, schnelle Entscheidungen und ein offenes Ohr auch für das, was dich persönlich bewegt. Das sind WIR Transformation ist für uns kein Trend, sondern unser Auftrag: Seit 1995 begleitet die avenit Group Unternehmen dabei, sich für die digitale Zukunft neu aufzustellen - ganzheitlich, strategisch und mit klarem Blick für nachhaltige Erfolge. Mit avenit und Vusyon vereinen wir zwei starke Kräfte - langjährige führende Digitalexpertise und modernste KI-Technologie - zu einem Partner für maßgeschneiderte Lösungen, die wirklich funktionieren. Wir glauben daran, dass nachhaltiger Erfolg auf Augenhöhe entsteht; im echten Dialog mit unseren Kunden. Unsere 60 Kolleg:innen lassen diese Vision jeden Tag zur Realität werden. Werde Teil eines Teams, das Zukunft nicht nur denkt, sondern gestaltet. Unser innovatives KI-Team in der Vusyon GmbH sucht Verstärkung, um unsere KI-Plattform für den Mittelstand weiter zu entwickeln. Neugierig, was uns dort besonders macht? Mehr erfährst du hier: https://vusyon.ai/ Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

We replace manual and paper-based processes with real-time, data-driven workflows, turning chaos into connected systems and making truck handling fully digital. Every step we automate today lays the foundation for terminals and depots to operate autonomously tomorrow. We are CONROO and we are driving logistics to autonomy. Tasks As a Product Owner at CONROO, you'll be one of the people steering where our product goes next. You join Scrum ceremonies and observe how requirements and priorities are managed. You align and guide a cross-functional team. You take ownership of user stories, acceptance criteria, and product requirements. You take an active role in Scrum management and coordination. raw.title: Product Owner | Full Time (m/w/d)
raw.description:
Who Are We ?

🚧 Picture logistics that run like clockwork — fast, smart, and seamless.

Autonomous logistics does not start with self-driving trucks. It starts with CONROO.

At CONROO, we are building an intelligent infrastructure that drives terminals and depots towards autonomy by connecting truck drivers, terminals, and depots through continuous data flows. We replace manual and paper-based processes with real-time, data-driven workflows, turning chaos into connected systems and making truck handling fully digital.

Every step we automate today lays the foundation for terminals and depots to operate autonomously tomorrow.

We are CONROO and we are driving logistics to autonomy.

Tasks

As a Product Owner at CONROO, you'll be one of the people steering where our product goes next. You'll spend time with customers and stakeholders to really understand what they need, then turn that into requirements the team can actually build from. You'll work closely with our developers day to day, answering questions, and making calls when priorities need to shift. It's a role with real ownership in the sense that what you decide matters, and you'll see it show up in the product.

🎖 What Success Looks Like

In your first month

  • You become familiar with the company, product, development process, customers, and key business areas and projects.
  • You work closely with Tech, Sales, and other teams to understand customer needs, business objectives, and product priorities.
  • You join Scrum ceremonies and observe how requirements and priorities are managed.
  • You align and guide a cross-functional team. Setting clear priorities, offering direction, and helping people do their best work.

By 3 months

  • You analyse and manage project requirements and stakeholder demands.
  • You independently create, prioritize, and maintain the product backlog based on customer needs and business objectives.
  • You take ownership of user stories, acceptance criteria, and product requirements.
  • You take an active role in Scrum management and coordination.
  • You ensure our product meets UX standards, quality standards, and relevant regulatory requirements.
  • You will communicate product vision, goals, priorities, and progress to internal and external stakeholders.
  • You communicate directly with customers and stakeholders to understand their needs and translate them into actionable requirements.
  • You will have full ownership of assigned projects and topics and manage them with increasing autonomy.

By 6 months

  • You independently manage projects and requirements from initial stage through implementation.
  • You have full ownership of Scrum processes and ensure effective collaboration and communication across teams.
  • You proactively identify customer needs, product opportunities, risks, and areas for improvement.
  • You contribute significantly to product development and prioritisation.
  • You consistently improve project management, requirements management, and quality processes where needed.
  • You operate autonomously while keeping relevant stakeholders aligned and informed.
  • You become the trusted point of contact for product-related topics across Tech, Sales, and other teams.

Requirements

🚀 What You Need to Be Successful

  • You bring 5+ years of experience as a Product Owner in a SaaS environment.
  • You are a native German speaker and fluent in English.
  • You have experience working with SCRUM and agile development processes.
  • You have experience in specifying requirements and developing user and technical stories.
  • You possess a solid understanding of technology, software development, and digital products.
  • You quickly grasp complex processes & technical requirements allowing you to create tailored solutions that deliver value for both clients and the business.
  • You bring strong communication skills and are confident working with a wide range of stakeholders, from C-level executives and internal teams to customers.
  • You bring strong organizational skills and are comfortable managing and prioritizing multiple requirements.
  • You are based in Nuremberg, Munich, or the surrounding area and are able to work from our Nuremberg or Munich office at least three days per week.

⚙️ Must Have Tools & Technologies

  • You have experience working with Jira or similar project management tools.
  • You are familiar with Figma or similar design and collaboration tools.
  • You have experience working with CRM systems.

💡It’s a Plus If You Have

  • Previous experience in the logistics industry.
  • Experience working in a startup or scale-up environment.

🌱 How We Set You Up to Be Successful

At CONROO, we don’t just define what success looks like — we actively support you in getting there through a structured, hands-on onboarding process during your first six months with us.

  • Onboarding sessions with your manager and our Head of Product and Engineering Alex, to understand your role, goals, and priorities.
  • Onboarding sessions with our COO, Ksenia and CEO, Felix, to learn about CONROO’s vision, strategy, and business.
  • HR onboarding with our People Partner, Hind, covering our values, tools, policies, and processes.
  • Product onboarding with our Product Owner, Özgür.
  • A buddy system during your first two months to help you onboard smoothly, get up to speed, and have a go-to person for questions.
  • Clear goals for your first 1, 3, and 5 months, with expectations defined from day one so you know how success is measured.
  • We know that starting a new role can be overwhelming. That’s why we provide clear documentation, a structured to-do list, and role-specific materials to help you get up to speed quickly.

Benefits

🌱About Our Team

We’re a team of around 30 curious minds working from our offices in Munich and Nuremberg — and remotely across Germany. We value ownership and a mindset driven by continuous learning. We take ideas seriously, see them through, and aren’t afraid to roll up our sleeves when challenges arise. As we grow, we keep raising the bar, looking for smarter, better ways to work — and have fun in the process together along the way.

🤝Why Us

💫 A mission that matters: Be part of a company that’s working on something meaningful and a purpose you can stand behind.

🏝️ Workation: Switch up your usual scenery and spend up to 30 days working remotely from a different location.

👊 Witness your actions shape our direction: You’re given the ownership and trust to make decisions that matter and the results are visible.

🏔️ Company getaway: Two annual team getaways where we work, unwind, and connect — away from the office. We went to the Austrian Alps last year, where should we go next?

🏢 Multiple office locations: Join us in one of our vibrant offices in Munich, Nuremberg, or Duisburg.

🎟️ Employee discounts: Use our employee discount portal to access attractive deals from top brands across tech, travel, fashion, home, and more — online and in-store.

🌍 International team: With 10 nationalities across a team of around 30 people, you’ll be part of a naturally diverse environment where different perspectives come together.

🧠 Hungry for knowledge? Our monthly S.H.A.R.E sessions teach you something new every month and give you the stage to share your passion & expertise too. If you want to go further, we’re happy to support you with a course, workshop, or other training opportunities.

title: Software QA Engineer II
description: <div class="content-intro"><h4><strong>Join Axon and be a Force for Good.</strong></h4> <p>At Axon, we’re on a mission to Protect Life. We’re explorers, pursuing society’s most critical safety and justice issues with our ecosystem of devices and cloud software. Like our products, we work better together. We connect with candor and care, seeking out diverse perspectives from our customers, communities and each other.<br><br>Life at Axon is fast-paced, challenging and meaningful. Here, you’ll take ownership and drive real change. Constantly grow as you work hard for a mission that matters at a company where you matter.</p></div><p><strong>Your Impact</strong></p> <p>Axon’s RF sensors detect and locate drones so public safety and critical infrastructure teams can protect airspace. You will own the test strategy and independent verification approach for RF sensor capabilities — spanning regression, integration, and real-world validation — so those systems are trustworthy in the lab and in the field. You will work closely with RF Engineering at the intersection of software, hardware, and real-world RF, helping turn technical evidence into confident product decisions.</p> <p><strong>Work Location:</strong> This role is based out of our Kassel, Germany office and follows a hybrid schedule. We rely on in-person collaboration and ask that team members work onsite Tuesdays through Fridays, with the flexibility to work remotely on Mondays, unless there is an approved workplace accommodation. We believe that connection fuels innovation, and our in-office culture is designed to foster meaningful teamwork, mentorship, and shared success.</p> <p><strong>What You’ll Do</strong></p> <ul> <li>Own the test strategy and independent verification approach for RF sensor software from design through release, adding rigor through regression, integration, and real-world validation.</li> <li>Design and own test strategies spanning feature, regression, integration / interface, system, and field validation. Combine automated coverage with targeted manual validation based on risk and technical feasibility.</li> <li>Develop in-depth functional tests for individual components of the RF sensor software, and keep those tests maintainable as the product evolves.</li> <li>Reproduce, isolate, and characterize issues on real sensor hardware and in test environments; capture clear reproduction steps, logs, and environment details.</li> <li>Build and maintain hardware-backed automated regression tests and supporting test tooling.</li> <li>Monitor and improve development and test systems and test hardware so environments stay stable, observable, and ready for daily use.</li> <li>Partner closely with RF Engineering and independently verify behavior in realistic environments and across system interfaces. Execute system, release, field, and acceptance testing with release stakeholders.</li> <li>Document test results and defects clearly, and contribute to software design reviews and after-action reviews for the work you own.</li> <li>Share knowledge with the wider team, give actionable feedback, and support newer engineers and interns through pairing, reviews, and onboarding.</li> <li>Use approved agentic AI tools regularly to design tests, analyze results, and draft documentation and review AI output against quality, security, and performance standards before you rely on it.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>What You Bring</strong></p> <ul> <li>A degree or vocational qualification in electrical engineering, computer science, embedded systems, or a related field</li> <li>3+ years of experience testing software that runs on or with hardware (embedded products, devices, sensors, or similar systems), including independently owning the test and quality approach for that work.</li> <li>Experience with RF, embedded, sensor, or similarly hardware-integrated systems, with the technical aptitude and curiosity to develop deep expertise in RF sensor technologies.</li> <li>Hands-on experience building and maintaining automated tests or test tooling, ideally in Python pytest, with the ability to independently support hardware-backed regression testing.</li> <li>Comfort working in Linux-based systems (SSH, Networking).</li> <li>A collaborative, quality-focused working style: you Join Forces with others, Own It on the quality of the work you take on, and speak up with candor when something is unclear or broken.</li> <li>It’s a plus if you have experience with drones or hardware-in-the-loop / continuous integration test setups and an interest in supporting others as they grow.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p>Don’t meet every single requirement? That's ok. At Axon, we Aim Far. We think big with a long-term view because we want to reinvent the world to be a safer, better place. We are also committed to building diverse teams that reflect the communities we serve.</p> <p>Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply to jobs unless they check every box in the job description. If you’re excited about this role and our mission to Protect Life but your experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification listed here, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.</p> <p><strong>Important Notes</strong></p> <p><em>The above job description is not intended as, nor should it be construed as, exhaustive of all duties, responsibilities, skills, efforts, or working conditions associated with this job. description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>About The Company</strong></p> <p>GROPYUS is a technology-based construction company focused on building multi-story residential buildings. GROPYUS is using scalable construction and manufacturing solutions to tap into a future market, boost Europe's strength in innovation, while also playing a substantial role in improving sustainability.</p></div><div class="job"> <h2><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><span style="font-size: 14pt;"><strong>About the Role:</strong></span></span></h2> <p>We’re looking for a Senior Strategic Sourcing Manager (all genders) to help shape and scale our Procurement function in Berlin. You will prepare and lead contract negotiations and contribute to the professionalisation and digitisation of Procurement.</p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Material Groups in Scope:</span></p> <ul> <li>Timber / CLT (cross-laminated timber) and related engineered wood products</li> <li>Steel (structural steel, connectors, fasteners, profiles)</li> <li>Windows / Façade systems (glazing, frames, façade elements, seals)</li> <li>MEP (Mechanical, Electrical, Plumbing) including HVAC, electrical components, piping and sub-assemblies</li> </ul> <h2><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><span style="font-size: 14pt;"><strong>What You'll Be Doing:</strong></span></span></h2> <h2><span style="font-size: 12pt;">1) Build strategic procurement foundations</span></h2> <ul> <li>Establish and implement strategic procurement processes (e.g., sourcing methodology, governance, templates, KPIs).</li> <li>Develop the first material group strategies (category roadmaps, supplier landscape, TCO logic, risk and sustainability criteria) and drive implementation across the organisation.</li> <li>Shape supplier segmentation and SRM routines (performance reviews, development plans, risk mitigation).</li> <li>Ensure cross-functional alignment with Engineering, Production, Quality and Project teams to translate requirements into scalable sourcing strategies.</li> </ul> <h2><span style="font-size: 12pt;">2) Lead sourcing &amp; negotiations</span></h2> <ul> <li>Own supplier discovery, RFx, benchmarking and award decisions for construction-material categories.</li> <li>Prepare and execute commercial and contractual negotiations (pricing, frameworks, terms &amp; conditions) in collaboration with Legal/Finance and key stakeholders.</li> <li>Drive supplier qualification and continuous improvement with a focus on availability, quality, lead times, and total cost.</li> <li>Build strong partnerships across Europe and proactively manage supply risks (capacity, market volatility, compliance).</li> </ul> <h2><span style="font-size: 12pt;">3) Enable procurement professionalisation &amp; B. description: <p><strong>Über AlixPartners</strong></p> <p>Expertise, Umsetzungsstärke, Verantwortung – AlixPartners steht für messbare Ergebnisse „when it really matters“. Als global agierende Unternehmensberatung helfen wir unseren Klienten dabei, schnell und entschlossen auf ihre wichtigsten Herausforderungen zu reagieren. Unsere erfahrenen Beraterinnen und Berater sind spezialisiert darauf, Unternehmenswerte zu schaffen, zu schützen und wiederherzustellen. Vom „manager magazin“ und der Wissenschaftlichen Gesellschaft für Management &amp; Beratung (WGMB) wurde AlixPartners 2023 als umsetzungsstärkstes Beratungsunternehmen ausgezeichnet. Seit über 40 Jahren unterstützt AlixPartners seine Klienten – mit inzwischen knapp 4000 MitarbeiterInnen in 27 Büros weltweit.</p> <p><strong>Unser Angebot</strong></p> <p>Wirkungsvoll, hands-on und pragmatisch: Bei AlixPartners treibt Ihre Leidenschaft Ihre Karriere – durch hohe Leistung, Initiative und Resultate. Gemeinsam mit sehr erfahrenen Teammitgliedern werden Sie in kleinen Teams, Seite an Seite mit Eigentümer:innen, Vorstandsmitgliedern und Senior Management zusammenarbeiten. Sie liefern schnell umsetzbare Lösungen für dringende Fragestellungen, oft in (zeit-) kritischen Situationen, bei denen viel auf dem Spiel steht.</p> <p>Durch unseren <a href="https://www.alixpartners.com/de/ueber-uns/">One-Firm Firm</a> Ansatz bieten wir länderübergreifende Möglichkeiten für Weiterbildung sowie zur persönlichen und professionellen Entwicklung.</p> <p>Außerdem erwartet Sie ein attraktives Gehaltspaket mit umfassenden Benefits und zahlreiche Initiativen unserer <a href="https://www.alixpartners.com/our-firm/responsible-business/culture/employee-resource-groups/">Employer Resource Groups</a> – sprechen Sie uns gerne darauf an.</p> <p><strong>IT Transformation:</strong></p> <p>Digital- und IT-Kompetenz ist mittlerweile in jedem der AlixPartners-Projekte ein entscheidender, etablierter Bestandteil. Unsere Expert:innen helfen Unternehmen pragmatisch bei der effizienten Nutzung von modernen Digitaltechnologien, um schnellstmöglich Wettbewerbs-, Kosten- und Betriebsvorteile zu erzielen.</p> <p>Die Digital Practice von AlixPartners ist auf einem starken Wachstumskurs und sucht erfahrene Berater:innen, die Spaß daran haben, Digital- und IT-Kenntnisse bei der Bewältigung der brennendsten Problemstellungen von Unternehmen einzusetzen.</p> <p><strong>Business Management Consulting:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Als AI &amp; Data Consultant werden Sie eine Schlüsselrolle spielen, indem Sie nicht nur die Geschäftsabläufe unserer Kunden optimieren, sondern auch zukunftsweisende KI-Strategien entwerfen, welche die Wettbewerbsposition unserer Kunden dauerhaft verbessern.</li> <li>Sie übersetzen komplexe Geschäftsprobleme in umsetzbare Technologiekonzepte und präsentieren wichtige Erkenntnisse und Lösungen auf Managementebene.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Data and Technology:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Extrahierung, Verarbeitung und Analyse von Daten aus einer Vielzahl von strukturierten und unstrukturierten Unternehmensquellen, Drittanbietern und öffentlich verfügbaren Daten.</li> <li>Nutzung von Cloud-Datenverarbeitungs-Frameworks wie Apache Spark, Databricks o.ä. zur Verarbeitung und Analyse komplexer, großer Datenmengen.</li> <li>Idealerweise Erfahrung mit der Nutzung von Cloud-Produkten und -Lösungen über APIs, insbesondere MS Azure und AWS.</li> <li>Entwurf mehrstufiger Datenpipelines, die skriptgesteuerte Transformationen und API-Aufrufe zu verschiedenen Diensten kombinieren.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Data Science:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Einsatz von Python oder R zur Analyse und Modellierung komplexer und umfangreicher Daten.</li> <li>Entwicklung und Anwendung von Modellen für Clustering, Klassifikation, Regression, Anomalieerkennung, natürliche Sprachverarbeitung oder GenAI.</li> <li>Erstellung von KI-Modellen, Algorithmen und Anwendungen sowie Integration der entwickelten KI-Lösungen in bestehende Geschäftsprozesse.</li> <li>Gestaltung und Umsetzung von Berichten und Visualisierungen, die Ergebnisse klar, prägnant und ansprechend darstellen und dabei den Geschäftszielen und zentralen analytischen Fragestellungen entsprechen.</li> <li>Verständliche Vermittlung technischer Ansätze, Implementierungen und Ergebnisse an ein nicht-technisches Publikum.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Ihr Profil</strong></p> <ul> <li>Mindestens 3 Jahre relevante Berufs- oder Beratungserfahrung, idealerweise in der Management- oder IT-Beratung.</li> <li>Problemlösungsorientierte, unternehmerische und stark analytische Persönlichkeit sowie hervorragende Kommunikations- und Interaktionsfähigkeiten.</li> <li>Nachweisbare Erfahrung in der Nutzung datenbasierter Analysen zur Entwicklung von Strategien und zur Verbesserung der Unternehmensleistung.</li> <li>Tiefgehende Kenntnisse im Umgang mit Daten und Technologien sowie einer oder mehreren datenorientierten Programmiersprachen wie SQL, Python, R.</li> <li>Erfahrung mit allgemeinen Programmiersprachen wie Java, C++, Rust, Go, JavaScript ist von Vorteil.</li> <li>Hervorragende akademische Qualifikationen: Master, Diplom, PhD oder vergleichbarer Abschluss.</li> <li>Verhandlungssicher in Deutsch und Englisch, weitere Fremdsprachen sind von Vorteil.</li> <li>Hohe Reisebereitschaft – hybrides Reisemodell, title: Senior Specialist, Employee Relations - EMEA
description: <div class="content-intro"><h2><strong>About Remote</strong></h2> <div><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">Remote is solving modern organizations’ biggest challenge – navigating global employment compliantly with ease. We make it possible for businesses of all sizes to recruit, pay, and manage international teams. With our core values at heart and future focused work culture, our team works tirelessly on ambitious problems, asynchronously, around the world. You can find Remoters working from 6 different continents (Antarctica left to go!) and all of our positions are fully remote.<br><br><span class="discussion-id-2f7cb4da-dab4-8068-a80f-001c50b2d808 suggestion-update notion-enable-hover" data-token-index="0">With Innovation as one of the core values, we have built Automation and AI capabilities into the requirements for every role.</span><br><br>We encourage every member of the Remote team to bring their talents, experiences and culture to the table to help us build the best-in-class HR platform.</span></div> <div>&nbsp;</div> <div><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">If you are energetic, curious, motivated and ambitious, be part of our world. Apply now and define the future of work!</span></div></div><h2>What this job can offer you</h2> <p>As a critical extension of our clients’ HR teams, we navigate and advise on the intricate paths of global employment with unmatched speed, expertise, and precision. The vision of the Lifecycle team at Remote is not just about maintaining the gold standard in HR practices; it’s about elevating it, integrating cutting-edge technology solutions, and enriching customer experiences in over 80+ countries. On this team, your work directly influences our ability to sustain and extend our compliance coverage, continuously enhance our customer journeys, and significantly increase our operational capacity. You’re not just part of a team; you’re at the forefront of shaping the future of work, ensuring every interaction is fast, intuitive, and profoundly impactful. Dive into a role where your passion for innovation, commitment to excellence, and drive to make a global difference aligns with our mission to empower organizations worldwide to employ anyone, anywhere — compliantly.</p> <p>The Lifecycle Specialist, Employee Relations &amp; Transitions manages employee exits for Remote's external employees with a focus on legal compliance and providing delightful customer service. Additionally, the specialist provides first-level Employee Relations support, guiding clients through workplace concerns and coordinating appropriate resources when needed.</p> <p>As part of a larger employee Lifecycle team, the Specialist is also expected to contribute to process improvements and initiatives in line with Remote's strategic goals and values.</p> <h2>Key Responsibilities</h2> <h3>Offboarding</h3> <ul> <li>Manage and resolve end-to-end employee exits across multiple international jurisdictions, prioritizing a superior offboarding experience for Remote's clients and their employees.</li> <li>Provide sound guidance and manage clients' requests on various HR matters, including but not limited to termination, resignation and transfer procedures, employment contracts, and redundancy processes, ensuring legal compliance and best practices.</li> <li>Lead and facilitate meetings with clients and external employees, including but not limited to workforce reduction consultation meetings, administrative hearings, negotiations in separations and settlements, providing guidance on terminations, and delivering termination outcomes.</li> <li>Influence and negotiate positive outcomes in complex terminations, balancing multiple stakeholders with competing interests.</li> <li>Liaise with and coordinate various internal and external stakeholders to ensure compliance in offboarding activities and audits, including but not limited to payroll, legal counsel, government bodies, and trade unions.</li> <li>Draft, tailor and administer all termination and supplementary documents with accuracy and attention to detail, ensuring employee records are maintained with strict adherence to privacy and confidentiality regulations.</li> <li>Process offboarding on Remote's internal HRIS platform, collaborating with various internal stakeholders, such as Customer Success, Legal, Payroll, Benefits, Time and Attendance, amongst other verticals, to ensure all aspects of the employee exit are administered correctly and promptly.</li> <li>Be the subject-matter expert and respond to internal and external queries on all offboarding matters in conjunction with Lifecycle's internal stakeholders.</li> <li>Navigate clients through Remote's Employee Relations resources and guides, helping them understand applicable policies and processes.</li> <li>Conduct preliminary assessment of workplace concerns, identifying key facts and applicable local regulations.</li> <li>Coordinate with internal and external stakeholders to ensure appropriate handling of employee relations matters.</li> <li>Support clients in understanding progressive disciplinary approaches and documentation requirements.</li> <li>Monitor ongoing employee relations cases, ensuring timely follow-up and coordination with relevant stakeholders.</li> <li>Actively identify opportunities for and contribute to process improvements, automation, product development and overall customer and title: Member Experience Manager - Frankfurt
description: Member Experience Manager Über das Unternehmen: Industrious ist der führende Premium-Anbieter von Flexible Workspace und bietet einige der am besten bewerteten Arbeitsorte der Branche. Unser Antrieb ist es, für Teams jeder Größe und in jeder Entwicklungsphase großartige Arbeitserlebnisse zu schaffen - und das gilt ebenso für unser eigenes Team. Wir sind überzeugt, dass herausragende Arbeitsbedingungen durch die Menschen entstehen, mit denen man zusammenarbeitet, und durch die Herausforderungen, die man gemeinsam meistert. Deshalb suchen wir Kolleginnen und Kollegen, die gerne über den Tellerrand hinausdenken und in einem wirklich kollaborativen Umfeld aufblühen. Bei Industrious fördern wir neue Ideen, unterstützen uns gegenseitig und feiern gemeinsame Erfolge. Wir freuen uns darauf, die Arbeitsumgebungen von Menschen nachhaltig zu verbessern - und hoffen, dass du Teil dieser Mission werden. Erfüllte Arbeitstage entstehen, wenn Menschen am Arbeitsplatz sie selbst sein können. Vielfalt in Herkunft, Perspektiven und Ideen ist für unseren Erfolg entscheidend – sowohl bei der Gestaltung herausragender Arbeitsplatz-Erlebnisse für unsere Mitglieder als auch im täglichen Miteinander. Industrious setzt sich für ein inklusives und respektvolles Umfeld ein, das Individualität wertschätzt und Raum für unterschiedliche Persönlichkeiten bietet. Bei uns zählt, wer Du bist und was Du einbringst. Wir feiern unsere Mitarbeitenden als einzigartige Persönlichkeiten, die gemeinsam als Team Außergewöhnliches erreichen können. Um mehr zu erfahren, besuchen Sie www.industriousoffice.com/careers . Über die Rolle: Unsere Member Experience Manager sind zentrale Ansprechpartner, Problemlöser, Impulsgeber und Gestalter eines herausragenden Member-Erlebnisses. Du bist die vertraute Verbindungsperson für unsere Mitglieder und die Persönlichkeit, die jeder kennt. In der Leitung deines Standortes setzt du deinen ausgeprägten Geschäftssinn ein, um Prozesse zu koordinieren, Kommunikation klar zu steuern und einen reibungslosen Betrieb sicherzustellen. Du begegnest Entscheidungsträgern auf Augenhöhe und scheust dich nicht, Fragen zu stellen, wenn Informationen fehlen. Du verbindest dich aktiv mit dem lokalen Geschäftsumfeld. Du repräsentierst Industrious selbstbewusst in deinem Markt und identifizierst potenzielle Mitglieder, denen du ein außergewöhnliches Arbeitserlebnis ermöglichen möchtest. Durch deine echte Neugier und deinen beratenden Ansatz verstehst Du die Bedürfnisse von Menschen und findest passende Lösungen. Du planst inspirierende Events und schätzt die anspruchsvolle Arbeit hinter den Kulissen, die solche Momente möglich macht. Vor allem aber: Du unterstützt andere mit Freude und Überzeugung. Industrious hilft Unternehmen jeder Größe dabei, ein Arbeitsumfeld zu finden, in dem du dein volles Potenzial entfalten können. Unser Team definiert Produktivität neu – durch ein modernes, menschenzentriertes Arbeitserlebnis. Wir sind Industrious. Exzellenz ist keine Selbstverständlichkeit. Wir erreichen sie nur mit einem Team von Menschen, die umsichtig handeln, unkonventionell denken und neue Wege nicht scheuen. Wenn du Teil dieser Mission werden möchten, freuen wir uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen. Du weißt, dass du erfolgreich sein wirst, wenn: Du erkennst die wichtigsten Bedürfnisse von Unternehmen treffsicher und begleitest sie souverän als zuverlässige Partnerin oder zuverlässiger Partner zu wirksamen Lösungen. Du weißt, was deine Community liebt, und stellst Programme zusammen, die du genießen und auf die du stolz bist (du postest sogar auf Instagram darüber!) Du passt hervorragend zu dieser Rolle, wenn: Keine Mitgliederanfrage zu groß oder zu klein ist für dich Du schöpfst Energie aus der Zusammenarbeit mit Menschen und agierst als starke Teamplayerin bzw. starker Teamplayer. Deine ausgeprägte Liebe zum Detail wird von Ihrem Umfeld geschätzt und macht sich in der Qualität Ihrer Arbeit bemerkbar. Du verfügst über eine hohe Resilienz und wissen, dass Weiterentwicklung durch das Meistern anspruchsvoller und unvorhersehbarer Situationen entsteht. Du bist flexibel und pragmatisch: Du packst an, wenn es nötig ist, und behältst zugleich das große Ganze im Blick. Als Member Experience Manager bist du verantwortlich für das Member-Erlebnis in deinem Gebäude. Du stellst außerdem sicher, dass wir die Bedürfnisse unserer Mitglieder erfüllen und die globalen Industrious-Standards und -Ziele in Bezug auf die Member-Zufriedenheit erreichen. Mitgliederbindung & Engagement: Pflege wichtiger Kundenbeziehungen- übernimm die Betreuung von Eskalationen und sorge für eine hohe Mitgliederzufriedenheit, einschließlich der Überwachung und Verbesserung des NPS. Gebäudebetrieb und -management: Sorge für operative Exzellenz, indem du Qualitätsstandards sicherstellst, SLAs einhältst, OPEX überwachst und Eskalationen mit dem Gebäude, Vermieter oder Dienstleistern löst. Unterstütze übergreifende Anforderungen im Gebäude, indem du bei Bedarf Community-Aufgaben übernimmst und mit Sales, Account Management und anderen internen Teams koordinierst. Teamführung: Führe und unterstütze die Gebäudeteams, indem du ein starkes Onboarding sicherstellst, ihnen die benötigten Tools zur Verfügung stellst und eine ausgewogene Präsenz über mehrere Standorte hinweg sicherstellst. Coache und entwickle Teammitglieder durch wöchentliche 1:1-Gespräche, persönliche Entwicklungspläne, Leistungsanerkennung und Wachstumschancen. Verfolge die Leistung kontinuierlich und führe regelmäßige Reviews durch. Budgetplanung & Kostenkontrolle: Unterstütze die Erstellung monatlicher, vierteljährlicher und jährlicher Budgets und überprüfe regelmäßig die finanzielle Leistung des Gebäudes, um Bereiche für effizientere Ausgaben und operative Verbesserungen zu identifizieren. About the Company: Industrious is the largest premium workplace-as-a-service provider and home to the highest-rated workplaces in the industry. Everything we do comes down to creating great days for teams of all sizes and stages, including our own. We believe that what makes a great day at work is the people on your team and the problems you get to solve together. We’re looking for people who love thinking outside the box and thrive in a truly collaborative setting. As teammates, we encourage new ideas and toast every win. We’re excited about having a meaningful impact on people’s workplace experience. Great days also start when everyone can be their authentic self at work. Diversity of backgrounds, thoughts, and ideas is critical to our success in delivering great workplace experiences, both for our members and for each other. Industrious is committed to creating an inclusive, respectful environment that embraces your individuality and quirkiness. You are valued for who YOU are. We celebrate our people as individuals who can accomplish great things when we work together as one team. To learn more, visit www.industriousoffice.com/careers . About the Role: You know you will be successful when: You accurately recognize the key needs of companies and confidently guide them to effective solutions as a reliable partner. You know what your community loves and put together programs that you enjoy and are proud of (you even post about it on Instagram!) You are a great fit for this role if: No member request is too big or too small for you. You draw energy from working with people and act as a strong team player. Your pronounced love for detail is appreciated by those around you and is noticeable in the quality of your work. You have high resilience and know that development comes from mastering demanding and unpredictable situations. You are flexible and pragmatic: You lend a hand when necessary while keeping the big picture in mind. As a Member Experience Manager , you are responsible for the member experience in your building. You also ensure that we meet the needs of our members and achieve the global Industrious standards and goals for member satisfaction. Member Retention & Engagement: Cultivate important client relationships - take on the management of escalations and ensure high member satisfaction, including monitoring and improving NPS. Building Operations and Management: Ensure operational excellence by securing quality standards, adhering to SLAs, monitoring OPEX, and resolving escalations with the building, landlord, or service providers. Support overarching requirements in the building by taking on community tasks when needed and coordinating with Sales, Account Management, and other internal teams. Team Leadership: Lead and support the building teams by ensuring strong onboarding, providing them with the necessary tools, and ensuring a balanced presence across multiple locations. Coach and develop team members through weekly 1:1 meetings, personal development plans, performance recognition, and growth opportunities. Continuously track performance and conduct regular reviews. Budget Planning & Cost Control: Support the creation of monthly, quarterly, and annual budgets and regularly review the building's financial performance to identify areas for more efficient spending and operational improvements. Member Experience Manager About the Company: Industrious is the largest premium workplace-as-a-service provider and home to the highest-rated workplaces in the industry. Everything we do comes down to creating great days for teams of all sizes and stages, including our own. We believe that what makes a great day at work is the people on your team and the problems you get to solve together. We’re looking for people who love thinking outside the box and thrive in a truly collaborative setting. As teammates, we encourage new ideas and toast every win. We’re excited about having a meaningful impact on people’s workplace experience. Great days also start when everyone can be their authentic self at work. Diversity of backgrounds, thoughts, and ideas is critical to our success in delivering great workplace experiences, both for our members and for each other. Industrious is committed to creating an inclusive, respectful environment that embraces your individuality and quirkiness. You are valued for who YOU are. We celebrate our people as individuals who can accomplish great things when we work together as one team. To learn more, visit www.industriousoffice.com/careers . About the Role: Our Member Experience Managers are the go-to problem solvers, momentum drivers, and experience creators for our members. You’re the connector and the person everyone knows. As the manager of your own location you rely heavily on your business sense to organize all the details and communications to ensure a smooth operation. You can hold your own when speaking with a CEO because anything you don’t know, you’re comfortable asking. Your drive makes you excited to connect with the broader business community. You’re proud to represent Industrious in your local market and actively identify potential members so that you can deliver them an exceptional day at work. Your genuine curiosity makes you successful at our consultative sales approach by uncovering and solving people’s needs. You pull together the most remarkable events and love the hard work it takes behind the scenes to make it happen. You love to help. Industrious helps companies of all sizes find their office home so that they can do their best work. Our team is rewriting the book on productivity by creating a new workplace experience. We are Industrious. Extraordinary is no ordinary achievement. We’ll only make this dream happen with a team of considerate collaborators who don’t think inside the box. In fact, we don’t even see one. Come join our team. You know you’re successful if: You can confidently identify companies' most important needs, enjoy being their tour guide, and deliver impactful solutions to them You know what your community loves and pull together programming that they enjoy and are proud of (they even instagram about it!) You’re a great fit for this role as: No member request is too big or too small for you to handle You’re energised by people and work well in a team Your attention to detail is something people comment on You’re resilient. You know growth only comes from embracing challenging and unpredictable days You’re willing to get your hands dirty one minute and think big picture the next Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

raw.description:
About us

We’re Cortea, a Berlin startup transforming audits with AI. Manual, document-heavy audits waste expert time while demand keeps rising. Our AI-powered software and specialized AI agents remove the repetitive work so auditors can focus on judgment.

Backed by top-tier VCs with >15m EUR funding, with a working product and paying customers, we’re rapidly scaling.

We value first-principles thinking, speed, trust, and kindness. We build side by side in our Berlin office.

Your Role

We are looking for an engineer with strong backend, data, and AI systems experience to build the evaluation and observability foundation for production-grade LLM agents used in complex audit workflows.

This role sits at the intersection of backend engineering, data infrastructure, and AI quality. You will build the evaluation systems that power our multimodal retrieval agents and continuously improve critical quality metrics across current and future pipelines.

You’ll work at the edge of applied AI and information retrieval, building multimodal agentic pipelines and solving hard context and agent-harness engineering problems.

This is not a traditional analytics, BI, or dashboarding role. You should expect to write production code, design data architecture, work inside backend systems, and directly improve the quality, cost, reliability, and performance of LLM-based agents.

What you’ll do

You will help build and operate the technical systems around our AI agents, with a focus on data infrastructure, evaluation, observability, and optimization. You will:

  • Build online and offline evaluation systems for LLM agents, including pipelines that use golden datasets, ground-truth data, human review workflows, and experiment results.

  • Create automated quality gates so changes to prompts, context, models, or agent logic can be tested before reaching production.

  • Analyze large volumes of agent traces and executions in columnar and analytical databases such as BigQuery or ClickHouse to identify failure modes, quality regressions, latency issues, reliability gaps, and cost optimization opportunities.

  • Build reliable data retention and replay mechanisms for long-term analysis of production agent behavior.

  • Manage observability tools for tracing, monitoring, debugging, and experiment management of our audit agents.

  • Team up with backend engineers to improve the speed and reliability of our retrieval and reasoning agents.

You will fit into the role if you...

  • Have strong Python and/or backend engineering experience.

  • Have a solid understanding of how LLM and agent systems are evaluated—including deterministic checks, ground truth, LLM-as-judge, human review, and quality metrics—and can reason about when each approach is appropriate.

  • Have deployed and operated systems in the cloud, ideally on GCP.

  • Have hands-on experience building end-to-end retrieval or ML pipeline evaluation systems and using LLM observability or experimentation tools such as Braintrust, MLflow, Langfuse, or Weights & Biases.

  • Are comfortable working with analytical databases, data warehouses, columnar stores, and high-volume event or trace data.

  • Understand system design, reliability, observability, monitoring, logging, debugging, and operational trade-offs.

  • Bring senior-level engineering judgment: you can make architectural decisions, communicate trade-offs, and build systems that other engineers can extend.

  • Are comfortable with ambiguity, able to reason from first principles, and excited to build infrastructure for AI systems that are actively used in production.

Nice-to-haves that are a plus:

  • Designing data pipelines, ETL/ELT workflows, event-processing systems, or feedback loops for production data.

  • Building infrastructure around LLM-based products or agentic systems, including optimizing LLM usage, context windows, reasoning tokens, or model selection.

  • Working with production traces from complex distributed systems.

  • Building internal platforms for engineers, domain experts, or operations teams.

  • Using workflow orchestration systems such as Temporal or similar.

  • Familiarity with audit, finance, compliance, or other high-accuracy domains.

  • Experience in an early-stage startup or fast-moving engineering environment.

No-one checks every box. If you’ve shipped retrieval systems and like owning evaluations and pipelines, let’s talk.

What we offer

  • High impact & growth: Shape strategy at a scaling AI startup from day one.

  • Mission-driven culture: Ambitious team valuing first-principles thinking and bold ideas.

  • Attractive compensation: competitive salary plus significant equity.

  • Best tools for the job: Generous coding tools budget so you can use the best tools for the job.

  • Startup perks: Flexible vacation, team lunches, retreats, central Berlin office.

Interview process

  • First Call — Intro to Cortea with Liza

  • Second Call — Technical interview with Vlad

  • Third Call — Deep dive into our culture with our Co-Founder Philipp

  • On-site Day (Berlin) — Meet the team and work on a real problem together

We’re an equal-opportunity team and encourage women and underrepresented groups to apply.

raw.title: Senior/Staff Platform Engineer (m/f/x)
raw.description:
Your Role

We ship fast, and we intend to keep shipping fast. The consequence is that our system is outgrowing the amount of deliberate design that went into it. We run AI agents over customer documents in a domain where being wrong is expensive, and a lot of the load-bearing decisions about how those fit together are still implicit.

You will be making those decisions explicit and then making them hold. That means codifying golden paths, building the shared primitives and APIs that product engineers work on top of, owning the architecture of the system as a whole, and establishing what our reliability actually needs to be before an incident establishes it for us.

Platform at Cortea sits between software engineering, DevOps and SRE. Its customers are other engineers. This is not a DevOps role under a different name: you will spend more time in application code than in YAML, and the reason we want infrastructure experience is that we don't believe you can design a system well without being able to run it.

The bar we are hiring against is someone who has taken a system from nothing to production and owned it end to end. You picked the technology, argued the tradeoffs in writing, provisioned the infrastructure, and were responsible for it when it broke.


On AI

We use AI heavily and we want you to. What we are not looking for is someone who outsources their judgment to it.

The mental model of this system has to live in your head, not in a context window. Use agents to move quickly on implementation. Do the design, the reasoning and the writing yourself, and be able to defend every decision you ship.


What you'll do

Four areas, roughly in the order you will spend time on them. You won't work on all of them at once, but you should be open to any of them.

Product platform. Make the easiest way for product engineers to do something (the paved road, or golden path) also the most secure, reliable and scalable way by default. Build the shared primitives, libraries and APIs that hide complexity and carry our quality and observability standards with them. Own the architecture and the core stack: what gets standardized, what gets reused, and where the system should be in eighteen months.

Infrastructure, observability and reliability. Infrastructure as code by default, from cloud resources through to dashboards and alerts. Provision, run and tune our Kubernetes cluster and cloud footprint, and keep CI fast as the deploy rate grows. Define SLIs for the workloads that
matter, build SLOs on top of them, and make the alerting high-signal enough that people trust it. Drive down AI and infrastructure spend.

Security and compliance. Keep the internal foundations secure by default: IAM, dependency management, secrets. Own the authentication and authorization stack, including ReBAC models covering both humans and agents. Implement SOC 2 and ISO 27001 controls without taxing every future change.

AI dev tooling. Keep product engineers and their agents on the paved road by making sure the documentation and agent guidelines they need are in place. Shorten the path from design to implementation with standardized automations and development environments that stay close to production.


What this looks like in practice

  • A system of record for managing and distributing constantly evolving agent configurations, under strict auditability and tenant isolation requirements

  • The harnesses powering our AI agents, abstracting over use cases that change faster than the code

  • Centralized progress tracking that holds up across a growing number of parallel agent executions

  • Usage-based tenant billing with quotas and rate limiting across a growing set of products

  • SLIs for the background job system behind our agents (execution latency, AI spend, memory, CPU), then fixing the bottlenecks they expose at both the application and infrastructure level

  • A document pipeline handling dozens of file formats, very large spreadsheets and hundreds of parallel uploads, under a strong reliability requirement


You will fit into this role if you…

  • Have designed, built and operated distributed systems end to end, and enjoy understanding how every part interacts with the rest

  • Are strong at backend software engineering and at DevOps/SRE, and don't think of those as separate jobs

  • Write design docs, RFCs, ADRs, postmortems

  • Reach for simple, boring solutions first, can tell essential complexity from accidental, and know which corners are safe to cut and which ones compound

  • Can turn a hard problem on its head and find the alternative nobody proposed

Concretely, you have scaled Postgres or another relational transactional database under real load, run production Kubernetes, and built observability rather than inherited it: SLIs, SLOs, distributed tracing.

No one checks every box. If you have designed a system from scratch, run it in production, and can explain in writing why it is shaped the way it is, let's talk.


Nice-to-haves that are a plus:

  • Durable workflow orchestrators like Temporal, and background job and queue processing generally

  • Infrastructure for LLM-based products or agentic systems

  • Audit, finance, compliance, or another high-accuracy domain

  • Azure and/or GCP


This is probably not the right role if…

  • You would describe application code as someone else's responsibility. A large share of platform work here happens inside the product codebase.

  • Your answer to reliability is more process. We want guardrails, not gates.

  • You need a well-defined system to work in. Ours is not one yet, and shaping it is the job.


What you will get

  • You own the brand and shape how the product feels. Work face-to-face with experienced founders and learn directly from customer insights.

  • Real influence on strategy. In a small team of excellent engineers and operators with high autonomy, you will shape product direction. Best idea wins, regardless of seniority.

  • Fast, ambitious, and fun team. Decisions get made in hours, not weeks. Rapid experimentation is the default.

  • Meaningful equity and competitive salary. You are one of the first to build this, and you share in the upside.

  • A mission that matters. Building intelligent systems for a $200bn industry. From Berlin, with AI at the core.

  • Third Call — Deep dive into our culture with our Co-Founder Philipp
