raw.description:
About us

We’re Cortea, a Berlin startup transforming audits with AI. Manual, document-heavy audits waste expert time while demand keeps rising. Our AI-powered software and specialized AI agents remove the repetitive work so auditors can focus on judgment.

Backed by top-tier VCs with >15m funding, with a working product and paying customers, we’re rapidly scaling.

We value first-principles thinking, speed, trust, and kindness. We build side by side in our Berlin office.

Your Role

We're looking for an experienced engineer who's happy anywhere in the stack and turns complex audit workflows into product auditors rely on every day. You pick up whatever a problem needs, from the data model to the interface to the agents behind it.

A lot of what we build has no reference implementation. You're comfortable wading into something nobody has solved yet and shipping a first version that actually works.

Our engineering team is a small, flat group of builders: strong ICs who open a laptop when they see a problem instead of scheduling a meeting. Everyone owns real product and architecture decisions, and that's exactly what we want more of.

What you'll do

  • Build the interfaces auditors work in, partnering with design to turn complex flows into something that feels effortless

  • Build and improve the agents at the core of the product, plus the harnesses and eval pipelines around them

  • Make the long-running workflows behind the product reliable and debuggable, so failures surface fast instead of silently

  • Use AI heavily in your own workflow to move faster, without ever shipping output you can't stand behind

  • Drive the how in RFCs and technical discussions with other engineers, and partner with product on the what

Qualifications

You'll fit here if you:

  • Have 5+ years shipping production web applications across the stack

  • Write production APIs and model the data behind them so it holds up under multi-tenancy and load

  • Are strong on the frontend and can build genuinely complex UI

  • Get how LLM agents actually work: agents, harnesses, tool use, and measuring quality with evals

  • Keep up with where AI is moving and bring the latest tools into how you work to make yourself faster

  • Bring a strong product mindset and real ownership of outcomes

  • Make architectural decisions, weigh trade-offs, and build things other engineers can extend

  • Are comfortable with ambiguity and work things out from fundamentals when there's no established answer

Nice-to-haves that are a plus:

  • Hands-on experience building agents, harnesses, or eval pipelines

  • Data-dense or workflow-heavy B2B products

  • Scaling multi-tenant systems as data and traffic grow

  • Early-stage startup or fast-moving engineering environment

  • React, TS, Tailwind, TanStack

  • High impact & growth: Front-row seat to scaling an AI startup with real ownership from day one

description: Wir suchen einen Sachbearbeiter Forderungsmanagement (m/w/d), der uns dabei unterstützt, offene Zahlungsfragen mit unseren Kunden zu klären, individuelle Vereinbarungen zu treffen und eine professionelle Vertragsabwicklung sicherzustellen. Dabei liegt dein Fokus vor allem auf dem telefonischen Kundenkontakt – du gehst aktiv auf Kunden zu, besprichst offene Zahlungen und findest mit einer überzeugenden und wertschätzenden Gesprächsführung verbindliche Lösungen. Du führst Verhandlungen telefonisch und per E-Mail, erläuterst vertragliche Grundlagen verständlich und bereitest Zahlungs- und Aufhebungsvereinbarungen vor. Dabei dokumentierst du alle Schritte sorgfältig, behältst Termine und Vereinbarungen im Blick und koordinierst bei Bedarf die weitere Bearbeitung mit unseren Rechtsanwälten. Wenn du gerne mit Menschen sprichst, überzeugend argumentierst und auch in anspruchsvollen Gesprächen souverän und lösungsorientiert bleibst, bist du bei uns genau richtig. Als Senior Fullstack Developer (m/w/d) gestaltest du leistungsfähige Anwendungen, vom Backend mit Java und Spring bis zum Frontend mit React. Dabei bringst du deine Expertise in die Entwicklung, automatisierte Bereitstellung und Qualitätssicherung der Software ein.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Entwicklung und Weiterentwicklung von Backend-Komponenten auf Basis von Java/Java EE und Spring

  • Umsetzung moderner Benutzeroberflächen mit React und JavaScript/TypeScript

  • Implementierung von Datenbankzugriffen und Anbindung relationaler Datenbanken wie Oracle oder PostgreSQL

  • Containerisierung von Anwendungen mit Docker sowie Verwaltung und Bereitstellung mit Kubernetes

  • Einbindung und Weiterentwicklung von CI/CD-Pipelines mit Jenkins zur Automatisierung von Build-, Test- und Deployment-Prozessen

DAS IST UNS WICHTIG

  • Mindestens 5 Jahre praktische Erfahrung in der Softwareentwicklung sowie fundierte Kenntnisse in Java/Java EE und Spring

  • Sicherer Umgang mit JavaScript/TypeScript und React zur Entwicklung moderner Frontend-Anwendungen

  • Erfahrung mit CI/CD-Prozessen und Jenkins zur automatisierten Erstellung, Prüfung und Bereitstellung von Anwendungen

  • Kenntnisse in der Containerisierung mit Docker und der Verwaltung von Anwendungen mit Kubernetes

  • KnowHow mit relationalen Datenbanken wie Oracle oder PostgreSQL sowie mit Applikationsservern wie JBoss von Vorteil

  • Idealerweise Erfahrung mit JUnit, Mockito und testgetriebener Entwicklung

  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse auf B2-Niveau sowie grundlegende Englischkenntnisse auf A2-Niveau

  • Bereitschaft zu regelmäßigen Vor-Ort-Terminen bei einem Remote-Anteil von etwa 80 %

DEIN NEUER ARBEITSPLATZ

  • Was bei uns zählt? Klar definierte Rollen, echtes Miteinander und ein gemeinsames Ziel. Wir nennen das Responsiveness – transparent, wertschätzend und zielorientiert.

raw.title: Business Analyst / Product Owner
raw.description:
Business Analyst / Product Owner

Trinetix is looking for a skilled Business Analyst / Product Owner with strong expertise in SCRUM and Agile delivery practices. The role combines business analysis and product ownership responsibilities, including defining and prioritizing product requirements, managing the backlog, and translating business needs into clear, actionable user stories and solutions.

Requirements

  • 4+ years of experience as a Business Analyst, Product Owner, or in a similar role
  • Strong knowledge of SCRUM methodology and practical experience working in Agile environments
  • Advanced English level, with strong communication skills in a professional environment
  • Advanced Ukrainian level, with strong communication skills in a professional environment
  • Proven experience collaborating with stakeholders, development teams, and product leadership
  • Experience managing and prioritizing product backlogs based on business value and priorities
  • Experience with backlog refinement, defining acceptance criteria, and writing clear, actionable user stories
  • Ability to translate business needs into functional and technical requirements
  • Strong communication, facilitation, and stakeholder management skills
  • Experience working with tools such as Azure DevOps, Microsoft Teams, Microsoft Excel, Confluence or SharePoint, and Miro

Nice-to-haves

  • Experience owning a product backlog or acting as a Product Owner
  • Legal domain knowledge or experience working on legal-related products or projects
  • Experience supporting or leading sprint planning and other Agile ceremonies
  • Understanding of the product development lifecycle and software development processes
  • Understanding of technical terminology and ability to communicate effectively with development teams
  • Experience working in cross-functional, distributed teams
  • Familiarity with enterprise-level workflows or large-scale Agile environments

Core Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with stakeholders, product leadership, and development teams to understand business needs and define product requirements
  • Own and maintain the product backlog, ensuring requirements are clearly defined, prioritized, and aligned with business goals
  • Lead and facilitate backlog refinement sessions and support effective sprint planning
  • Define clear user stories, acceptance criteria, and requirements that are actionable for development teams
  • Prioritize requirements based on business value, stakeholder needs, dependencies, and delivery priorities
  • Translate business needs into functional and technical requirements while maintaining alignment between business and engineering teams
  • Support product decision-making by identifying gaps, dependencies, risks, and opportunities
  • Facilitate communication and alignment across stakeholders and cross-functional teams
  • Maintain product and requirements documentation using tools such as Azure DevOps, Confluence/SharePoint, Miro, etc.
  • Support Agile ceremonies and contribute to continuous improvement of the product development process

About Us  

Established in 2011, Trinetix is a dynamic tech service provider supporting enterprise clients around the world. 

Headquartered in Nashville, Tennessee, we have a global team of over 1,000 professionals and delivery centers across Europe, the United States, and Argentina. We partner with leading global brands, delivering innovative digital solutions across Fintech, Professional Services, Logistics, Healthcare, and Agriculture. 

Our operations are driven by a strong business vision, a people-first culture, and a commitment to responsible growth. We actively give back to the community through various CSR activities and adhere to international principles for sustainable development and business ethics.

raw.description:
Anstellungsdetails

Permanent Contract, Full- or Part-Time, Remote or Cologne / Düsseldorf / Darmstadt / Berlin


Info

Who we areWe are the tech powerhouse behind Kaufland’s international online marketplaces and a company within the Schwarz Group. Driven by a start-up mentality and working on an equal footing within flat hierarchies, we develop the best marketplace solutions for our customers, sellers and partners. #FromEuropeForEurope

Day by day, our Tech & Product Team of about 400 experts pursues the goal of creating the best possible customer shopping experience for our online marketplace. Through innovative technical developments, they not only create an outstanding shopping experience but also lay the foundation for an optimal selling experience for our sellers. Learn more about our division, areas, and cross-functional teams here!


Aufgaben

Your tasks – this is what awaits you in detail

  • You run and own our self-hosted Apache Kafka backbone and Schema Registry end-to-end, managing ACLs, client quotas, certificates, upgrades, and disaster recovery
  • You operate our Debezium-based change data capture pipelines, overseeing connectors, snapshots, offsets, replica lag, and BigQuery sink loaders 
  • You run our workloads on Kubernetes, including Navarch - our self-built workflow orchestrator executing ~7,500 SQL and Python tasks daily - owning resource management, autoscaling, and debugging
  • You automate and own access management and infrastructure as code across our self-hosted GitLab CI/CD pipelines, replacing manual tickets with code-driven policies
  • You own observability and infra costs - Datadog across Kafka and sink loaders, Slack-native alerting, and maintaining an honest view of K8s, Kafka retention, and log volume expenses
  • You carry your share of triage, one week in three - handling ingestion and access requests, schema alerts, and supporting analysts, while helping automate this layer via AI-assisted review
  • You act as a senior sparring partner alongside two senior data engineers (reporting to the Head of Data & Analytics) - driving design reviews and multi-quarter initiatives, with room to grow into BigQuery architecture over time: access frameworks, partitioning and slot strategy, the pipelines and models on top
  • Optional: You take part in our 24/7 on-call rotation


Profil

Your profile – this is what we expect from you

  • You have several years of experience operating production infrastructure you were personally responsible for, including on-call rotation. You have run systems that broke, can explain what went wrong and how you permanently fixed it, and can detail a specific trade-off you navigated backed by concrete numbers
  • You have deep hands-on expertise in Apache Kafka broker operations, including cluster sizing, partition rebalancing, replication, ISR behavior, and version upgrades
  • You have operated cross-system data replication in production - ideally Debezium on Kafka Connect, or database replication via binlog, GTID, WAL, or agent-based pipelines
  • You demonstrate strong production experience with Kubernetes, master resource management and autoscaling, and possess sharp debugging reflexes for complex failure modes
  • You manage infrastructure and access as code across multiple environments (ideally Terraform and Ansible; Pulumi, Helm or serious configuration management also counts) following a strict least-privilege IAM approach across multiple environments, ideally with GCP experience or transferable AWS/Azure knowledge
  • You use production-grade Python and SQL as practical tools, applying a cost-conscious mindset to query performance, scanning volume, and data pruning
  • You thrive in a low-process, Kanban-driven environment where seniors self-organize, rotate weekly triage duties without micro-management, and prefer automating recurring requests over manually repeating them
  • Optional: You bring skills or interest in object-oriented design, data modeling/dbt, BigQuery architecture, orchestration frameworks (Airflow, Dagster), stream processing (Beam, Flink, Spark), or internal automation (n8n, AI triage bots).
  • You are fluent in English (C1 level) and enjoy working in an international team environment


Benefits

What we offer

  • Create your own work-life balance: You have the flexibility to choose between working remotely (within Germany) or from one of our locations in Cologne, Darmstadt, Düsseldorf, or in Berlin!
  • Do you want to move to Germany? No problem – we offer you an attractive relocation package to give you a smooth start. 
  • Urban Sports Club and RSG Group Fitness Studios: Get top deals for fitness, swimming, yoga and more
  • Mental Well-Being: We support you on your well-being journey with special offerings such as Instahelp, the digital platform for online psychological counseling
  • Vacation & Sabbatical: Enjoy 30 days of vacation per year and the opportunity to take a sabbatical once you have been part of the team for a certain period!
  • Option for Pluxee restaurant vouchers: Buy Pluxee vouchers through us and benefit from tax-advantaged meal allowances!
  • ‘Deutschlandticket’: We subsidize your train season ticket for more mobility
  • Employee Discount: You will receive a monthly coupon for Kaufland.de
  • Free choice of operating system: MacOS or Ubuntu Linux, it's up to you
  • Boost your growth: Benefit from our online language learning programs, diverse in-house training, and our automated 360-degree feedback. We cover the costs for relevant conferences, training opportunities, and approved team workshops to strengthen personal interactions
  • This is who we are: Our dynamic culture combines flat hierarchies, a start-up mentality, an international team of over 65 nationalities, and the strength of the Schwarz Group to provide you an agile and secure working environment.
  • We are team players: From day one, you will connect not only with your team but also with others through our digital onboarding journey, the buddy program, and regular team and company events, all-hands meetings, powerful mornings, and much more!
Check out our Principles & our blog for even more insights into our company culture!


Bewerben

Diversity at Kaufland e-commerceWe welcome applications from everyone, regardless of skin colour, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, disability, ethnic origin, religion and ideology. We are signatories to the Charta der Vielfalt (German Diversity Charter) – because we know that extraordinary things can only be achieved with diversity. Read more here! When applying, you can optionally include your pronouns in your resume.

Why are you the perfect fit for this position?
Don't bother with cover letters - we're interested in facts and figures! Feel free to share your Github profile with us in your application.

As we have very international teams, we would highly appreciate it to receive your CV or profile link in English.

We are looking forward to your application!

raw.title: (Senior) Account Manager (m/w/d)
raw.description:
Kurzbeschreibung

Du bringst Projekte sicher ins Ziel und gibst Kund:innen das Gefühl, in guten Händen zu sein?
Du kannst Performance-Daten analysieren, Creative-Ergebnisse einordnen und daraus klare strategische Empfehlungen ableiten?
Du kommunizierst klar, führst souverän durch Abstimmungen und behältst den roten Faden?

Dann suchen wir dich als (Senior) Account Manager (m/w/d) für unser adfriends-Team!*

*adfriends ist Teil der Friendventure-Gruppe


Deine Aufgaben

  • Du führst deine Kunden eigenverantwortlich und bist ihre zentrale Ansprechperson im Projektalltag
  • Deine Stärke liegt darin, Ziele und Anforderungen in klare Briefings, Timings und Next Steps zu übersetzen
  • Du planst und steuerst Social- und Advertising-Kampagnen von Kick-off bis Auswertung und Optimierung
  • Du ordnest Performance-Ergebnisse strategisch ein und leitest Handlungsempfehlungen ab
  • Du koordinierst die Zusammenarbeit zwischen Kreation, Performance/Media Buying und ggf. externen Partnern und sorgst für reibungslose Abläufe
  • Budget, Aufwand, Ressourcen und Prioritäten hast du jederzeit im Blick – ohne dass Qualität oder Tempo leiden
  • Auch im New Business packst du mit an: Du sprichst passende Unternehmen an, führst Erstgespräche, qualifizierst Anfragen und begleitest bis zum Angebot


Dein Profil

  • Du hast mindestens 3 Jahre Erfahrung im Projekt- oder Accountmanagement digitaler Marketingprojekte, idealerweise im Agenturumfeld
  • Social Ads und Performance-Prozesse sind dir vertraut und du kannst Teams sowie Kunden sicher durch Projekte führen
  • Strukturiertes Arbeiten gehört zu deinen Stärken: Du priorisierst sauber und behältst Timings, Budgets und Abhängigkeiten im Blick
  • Deine Kommunikation ist klar, professionell und empathisch – sowohl im Team als auch mit Kunden
  • Du kannst Anforderungen präzise dokumentieren und Briefings erstellen, mit denen Kreation und Media Buying direkt starten können
  • Hands-on-Mentalität, Eigeninitiative und Verantwortungsgefühl zeichnen dich aus
  • Auch neue Kontakte aufzubauen macht dir Spaß, weil du gerne beraten, Potenziale erkennen und Beziehungen entwickeln willst
  • Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse (C2) und sehr gute Englischkenntnisse


Deine Benefits

  • Friend ist Programm: Wir nennen es zuerst, denn das macht uns aus: Kolleg:innen, die sich Freunde nennen, füreinander einstehen und mit denen es Spaß macht zu arbeiten
  • Volle Flexibilität: Bei uns entscheidest du über Arbeitszeit und Arbeitsort – Hybrid-Work und Homeoffice? Wie es für dich gerade am besten passt!
  • Zukunftsorientiertes Arbeiten: Wir arbeiten am Puls der Zeit und setzen aktiv auf KI in unserem Leistungsportfolio
  • JobRad-Leasing: Ob für den Arbeitsweg oder die Wochenendtour – bei uns kannst du dein Wunschrad ganz einfach leasen
  • Mobilität nach Wahl: Wir unterstützen dich bei deinem Arbeitsweg mit einem Zuschuss zum Deutschlandticket und der Option auf einen Tankgutschein 
  • Work-Life-Balance: Schätzen wir genau wie Du und ist mit unserem flexiblen Arbeitsmodell gesichert.
  • Urlaubstage: 28 + 2 * 0,5 freie Tage für Weihnachten und Silvester
  • After-Work-Programm: Neben der Urban-Sports-Mitgliedschaft und regelmäßigen Team-Events erwartet dich unsere jährliche Workation
  • Weiterentwicklung: Wir bieten spannende Projekte und stetige Weiterentwicklung in einer Organisationskultur, in der der Status Quo auch hinterfragt werden darf
  • Drinks & Snacks: In unseren Büros findest du alles für dein Wohlbefinden – Kaffee, Limonade, Bier, frisches Obst und vieles mehr

 Beim Lesen der Stellenanzeige dachtest du dir "Hell Yes!"?

We're faithfully serving >200k/mo patients via Bolt Pharmacy. We're profitable. Our strategy exists at the intersection of two strong theses: The AI doctor that wins will get to escape velocity using GLP-1s, the fastest growing consumer product in history. The $2T European healthcare market is overlooked by the most talented builders. Our master plan: Step 0 → $100M/yr by end of 2025 : We went from $10M to $100M in 6 months serving the UK GLP-1 market. Step 1 → $1B ARR by end of 2026 : Over the last 12 months we've grown from 3k to 150k UK active GLP-1 patients. We'll continue this growth curve to hit $1B ARR. Step 2 → $10B ARR by end of 2028 : Blitzscale Europe. We'll be Europe's largest GLP-1 provider. Step 3 → $100B/yr by end of 2031 : Get regulatory approval across Europe for our Full Autonomous Prescribing (FAP) system. Win contracts at scale with European payers to mass replace human labor. We'll be the dominant full-stack AI doctor in Europe. Step 4 → $1T/yr by end of 2035 : With one line of code and zero human time, you can use AIOS to treat any patient globally with any medication. In so doing, we'll become the world's first trillion-dollar healthcare company. We're a young, founder-led company. This is still Day 1 and all our work is ahead of us. Being a Dispenser at Bolt Pharmacy We are building a world-class team. As a Dispenser at Bolt Pharmacy (part of AIOS), your fundamental role is to turn prescriptions into treatment patients can count on - safely, accurately and at pace. You'll be at the heart of our dispensing operation, selecting, labelling and securely packing medicines for patients across the UK. You'll take ownership of your work within your qualified scope, follow dispensing procedures precisely and escalate clinical questions to our pharmacists. Every prescription has a person behind it. You'll keep quality high as volumes grow. From protecting the cold chain and monitoring storage temperatures to managing stock and checking deliveries, you'll help keep medicines safe and orders moving. You'll report errors and near misses promptly, so we learn quickly and keep improving. Working alongside pharmacists, fellow dispensers and our stock and customer service teams, you'll help resolve issues before they delay treatment. You'll also support trainee dispensers and spot practical ways to make Bolt Pharmacy's operation more efficient. Your experience will help raise the standard of the whole team. Great performance means consistently processing 30+ orders per hour while maintaining over 99.5% dispensing accuracy, zero critical errors and full compliance with our procedures. Patients receive the right treatment, colleagues trust your work and we can serve more people with confidence. This is a full-time, on-site role at Bolt Pharmacy in Blackburn, UK, working standard business hours with possible shift patterns. You'll report directly to our Shift Lead and work closely with our Site Operations Lead, Michal Binkowski . You'll work most closely with Bolt Pharmacy's pharmacists, qualified and trainee dispensers, Stock Control and Customer Service, combining dispensing oversight, shared workloads and patient support. Key responsibilities Get every prescription right: Select, label and prepare medicines accurately within your qualified scope, following SOPs and escalating clinical queries to pharmacists. Keep treatment moving: Process and securely pack 30+ orders per hour while maintaining accuracy, safety and compliance. Protect every medicine: Maintain cold-chain controls, monitor fridge and room temperatures, and escalate storage deviations immediately. Take ownership of stock: Check incoming deliveries, maintain correct storage and rotation, and support stock takes so medicines are available when needed. Make quality everyone's business: Record errors, near misses and incidents promptly, keep workstations clean and compliant, follow hygiene and PPE procedures, and suggest practical improvements. Raise the team's standard: Guide trainee dispensers, support colleagues and work with Customer Service to resolve patient queries and order updates. Need to have Dispensing qualification: You hold a valid Buttercups certification or equivalent dispensing qualification. Experience at pace: You've worked in high-volume dispensing and can consistently meet a target of 30+ orders per hour without compromising safety. Attention to detail: You bring exceptional accuracy to medicine selection, labelling and prescription preparation. Ownership within your scope: You organise your workload independently, follow SOPs precisely and know when to involve a pharmacist. Professionalism: You're reliable, punctual and committed to patient safety and regulatory compliance. Nice to have Qualified experience: You've spent at least a year working as a qualified dispenser. Online pharmacy: You understand the demands of dispensing and dispatching treatment to patients remotely. Mentoring: You've trained or supported junior colleagues and can explain procedures clearly. Stock management: You bring experience in inventory control, stock rotation and keeping a busy dispensary supplied. Patient support: You've handled healthcare queries with care, clarity and professionalism. Pharmacy standards: You're familiar with GPhC requirements and how they translate into everyday practice. Our cultural standards We aim to make this your life's work. This should be the most challenging, most rewarding role of your life. Accordingly, these are the core cultural standards to which we hold ourselves & our team-members: Belief in the mission : We will have served 100 million patients by the end of 2035 and we transform the life of most patients who join. We have a lot of work to do. We are obsessed with our patients and are dedicated to the mission. Unwavering integrity : We are at the frontier, so we often live in ambiguity with no trodden path. When we can't look to others for guidance, we must maintain impeccable ethics and unwavering integrity. Only the paranoid survive : Bad sh*t is coming. By joining us, you're choosing to sail straight towards the storms with unhesitating conviction. However much we've already done, however far we've already come — it's still Day 1 and all our work is ahead of us. If we're average we fail : We are only interested in "insanely great", a focus on the quality of our execution that in everyday life would be considered pathological. We have a dedication to excellence and reject incompetence. Commitment to candor : That which can be destroyed by the truth should be. You get full transparency from the company and the company expects full transparency from you. We never say anything about someone that we wouldn't say to them directly. We give feedback with love and do not need to protect people from fleeting physical sensations. A maniacal sense of urgency : We execute at an intensity that most people think is impossible. Speed is critical and we need things done yesterday. We all work very hard and in such a competitive world there really is no other way to win. Enduring frugality : We are frugal. We hate being wasteful and we are anti-luxury. A culture of cheapness keeps us young. We spend our cash wisely & carefully — in a way that would make our grandmas proud. Bulldozing barriers : The world is malleable and we shape it. We truly believe this and act accordingly. We are relentlessly resourceful and are at the mercy of no-one but ourselves. You'll be shocked how capable you are and how much you can achieve. Keep your head down : We're boring people doing exciting work. We don't chase short-term status — we ignore short-term dopamine hits and focus on what matters. Outsiders will underestimate us and we revel in that. The power of focus : We live in a world of power laws and we cannot overestimate the unimportance of practically everything. Know your One Thing, and nail it. 🎯 "You just build a f*ing amazing experience. Make each step amazing. Make every decision in the long term interest of the customer. Give the customer massively more value than you take." Compensation & Benefits Our compensation package includes equity, giving you the opportunity to share in what we build. Training role: £13 per hour while you complete the required training and sign-off. Qualified role: £15 per hour in total compensation, including equity, once you have completed the required training and are qualified and signed off for the role. Benefits The stuff below is cool as well. Personal development: A £400 budget for books, courses and coaching to keep building your skills. Personal wellness: A £400 budget for the gym and health apps to support your wellbeing. GLP-1s: Get free membership with a clinic offering GLP-1s, if clinically applicable. Health coaching: Access free biweekly health coaching to help you stay healthy. Work coaching: Access free biweekly work coaching to stay sharp and calm. What are we missing? title: Senior Product Manager, Fisheries / IUUF
description: At Kpler, we are dedicated to helping our clients navigate complex markets with ease. By simplifying global trade information and providing valuable insights, we empower organisations to make informed decisions in commodities, energy, and maritime sectors.   Since our founding in 2014, we have focused on delivering top-tier intelligence through user-friendly platforms. Our team of over 850 experts from 69 countries works tirelessly to transform intricate data into actionable strategies, ensuring our clients stay ahead in a dynamic market landscape. Join us to leverage cutting-edge innovation for impactful results and experience unparalleled support on your journey to success.   As Senior Product Manager, Fisheries, you will own the Fisheries product end to end, from strategy and roadmap through to first release and go-to-market. Working closely with the Lead Product Manager – Maritime & Logistics, you will build a new product offering that brings together Kpler's vessel, ownership, port, and trade-flow data to address growing challenges around seafood supply chain transparency and illegal, unreported and unregulated (IUU) fishing. Your initial focus will be on building live fleet monitoring and catch and yield reporting , enabling procurement and compliance teams to monitor vessels, understand fishing activity, and access reliable information to support their due-diligence and traceability requirements. This is a high-impact opportunity to build a new product category from the ground up. You will work directly with seafood buyers, retailers, processors, certification bodies, regulators, RFMO stakeholders, and NGOs, as well as Product, Engineering, Data, Sales, and Marketing teams, to ensure the product delivers trusted and actionable intelligence. The role is ideal for an experienced product leader who is comfortable operating in an ambiguous, early-stage environment and has a track record of taking B2B data, analytics, or SaaS products from concept through to customer adoption. Key Responsibilities Own the Fisheries product strategy, vision, and roadmap , defining what gets built and in what order while balancing customer value, commercial opportunity, technical feasibility, and time to market. Lead the development and delivery of the first Fisheries product release , focused on live fleet monitoring and subsequently catch and yield reporting that procurement and compliance teams can rely on. Lead market and customer discovery with seafood buyers, retailers, processors, certification bodies, regulators, RFMO stakeholders, and NGOs to understand customer needs and translate insights into product direction. Define and refine the product proposition and customer experience , ensuring Kpler's data and intelligence are translated into clear, actionable outcomes for customers across the seafood supply chain. Establish the vessel identity, dark-behaviour, and catch-estimation methodologies underpinning the product, working with data and domain experts to ensure the outputs are credible, transparent, and trusted. Own positioning and competitive strategy , monitoring the existing commercial and NGO-adjacent landscape and clearly defining Kpler's differentiation. Lead the go-to-market strategy for the product, working with Sales and Product Marketing on positioning, messaging, packaging, pricing input, launch planning, and early customer adoption. Identify and develop strategic partnerships across the seafood supply chain, including data, certification, and distribution partnerships that can strengthen the product and accelerate adoption. Act as the key link between Product, Engineering, Data, Sales, and Marketing , creating alignment around product strategy, priorities, launch plans, and customer outcomes. Track product performance, customer feedback, delivery progress, and key risks, using evidence and market insight to continuously refine the roadmap and maximise product impact. Skills and Responsibilities 5–7 years of Product Management or senior commercial experience , ideally within maritime data, seafood supply chains, or a related B2B data/SaaS environment. Proven track record of owning products end-to-end , from strategy and customer discovery through to delivery, launch, and customer adoption. Strong track record of translating complex customer needs into clear product strategy, roadmap priorities, and product requirements , working closely with Product and Engineering teams. Strong understanding of the fisheries data landscape , including vessel tracking, IUU risk, catch documentation, and supply chain traceability. Experience operating in ambiguous, early-stage environments , with a pragmatic and iterative approach to building, launching, learning, and improving products. Strong commercial and go-to-market experience , including product positioning, packaging, pricing input, launch planning, and working closely with Sales and Marketing. Strong data and analytical literacy, with the ability to work effectively with data and engineering teams and understand maritime and trade data concepts such as AIS, vessel identity, geospatial analysis, ownership, and flows . Excellent stakeholder management skills, with the ability to build trusted relationships across technical, commercial, regulatory, and NGO audiences . Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate clearly with senior external stakeholders. Strong ownership mindset and a bias to action , with the confidence to make decisions, navigate uncertainty, and focus on delivering outcomes rather than perfection. Nice to have Direct experience within the fisheries or seafood sector , particularly procurement, traceability, or certification. Experience building and launching a new product line rather than managing an established product. An established network across seafood buyers, certification bodies, regulators, or fisheries NGOs . Understanding of relevant fisheries regulations, including IUU regulations, US SIMP, or the EU carding system . We are a dynamic company dedicated to nurturing connections and innovating solutions to tackle market challenges head-on. If you thrive on customer satisfaction and turning ideas into reality, then you’ve found your ideal destination. Are you ready to embark on this exciting journey with us?   We make things happen We act decisively and with purpose, going the extra mile.   We build together We foster relationships and develop creative solutions to address market challenges.   We are here to help We are accessible and supportive to colleagues and clients with a friendly approach.     Our People Pledge   Don’t meet every single requirement? Research shows that women and people of color are less likely than others to apply if they feel like they don’t match 100% of the job requirements. Don’t let the confidence gap stand in your way, we’d love to hear from you! We understand that experience comes in many different forms and are dedicated to adding new perspectives to the team.   Kpler is committed to providing a fair, inclusive and diverse work-environment. We believe that different perspectives lead to better ideas, and better ideas allow us to better understand the needs and interests of our diverse, global community. We welcome people of different backgrounds, experiences, abilities and perspectives and are an equal opportunity employer.       By applying, I confirm that I have read and accept the  Staff Privacy Notice Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Electrical Characterisation Engineer
description: About The Role and Team Quantum Motion is a fast-growing quantum computing scale-up based in London founded by internationally renowned researchers from UCL and Oxford University with over 40 years’ experience in developing qubits and quantum computing architectures. Bringing together state-of-the-art cryogenic facilities and an outstanding interdisciplinary team, we are developing quantum processors based on industrial-grade silicon chips, with the potential to radically transform computing power in areas such as materials modelling, medicine, artificial intelligence and more. Our Team Since 2021 our team has been listed every year in the “Top 100 Startups worth watching” in the EE Times in 2021 and 2022, and our technology breakthroughs have been featured in The Telegraph , BBC and the New Statesman . Our founders are internationally renowned researchers from UCL and Oxford University who have pioneered the development of qubits and quantum computing architectures. Our chairman is the co-founder of Cadence and Synopsys, the two leading companies in the area of Electronic Design Automation. We’re backed by a team of top-tier investors, and we have recently closed our Series C funding of $160 million. We bring together the brightest quantum engineers, integrated circuit (IC) engineers, quantum computing theoreticians and software engineers to create a unique, world-leading team, working together closely to maximise our combined expertise. Our collaborative and interdisciplinary culture is an ideal fit for anyone who thrives in a cutting-edge research and development environment focused on tackling big challenges and contributing to the development of scalable quantum computers based on silicon technology. This is a rare and exciting opportunity to be an employee at a scale-up shaping the future of quantum computing. There are vast opportunities for professional growth and to make an impact within the company. Our team of 100+ is based across London, Oxford, San Sebastián and Sydney, with our primary hub in Islington (London). We are looking for a Senior Electrical Characterisation Engineer to join our Process Integration team and play a key role in understanding, qualifying and improving the silicon devices at the heart of our quantum processors. You will sit at a fascinating intersection between semiconductor manufacturing and quantum hardware, working closely with foundries, process engineers and quantum engineers. You will use electrical characterisation and large-scale data analysis to understand manufacturing variability, identify the root causes of device behaviour, and feed those insights directly back into the semiconductor fabrication process. This is an opportunity to have a tangible impact on the yield, quality and scalability of quantum processors, working with some of the most advanced silicon technology being developed for quantum computing. Functions of the Role Drive electrical characterisation of fabricated silicon devices , developing and continuously improving high-throughput screening methods to assess key device parameters including threshold voltage, gate oxide reliability and channel mobility. Turn electrical data into manufacturing insight , identifying patterns, variability and device failures and connecting them back to semiconductor process steps such as photolithography, etching, oxide growth, CMP and doping. Develop automated measurement and test infrastructure , creating robust Python-based test routines and instrument-control workflows across room-temperature and, where appropriate, low-temperature wafer probing environments. Analyse large-scale electrical datasets using statistical process control, yield analysis and other data-driven techniques to monitor wafer uniformity, defect density and process drift. Work directly with semiconductor foundries and process engineers , providing clear, actionable feedback that can be used to improve device performance, consistency and yield. Build scalable characterisation processes , establishing testing standards, calibration procedures, SOPs and data pipelines that allow information to flow effectively between semiconductor process integration and quantum engineering teams. Help shape how we characterise the next generation of our technology , bringing your expertise and ideas to continuously improve our measurement capability as Quantum Motion scales. We are looking for someone who combines strong semiconductor device knowledge with a practical, data-driven approach to electrical characterisation. Experience - Essentials Master's or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Microelectronics, Semiconductor Physics, Materials Science or a closely related discipline. 3+ years' experience in semiconductor device testing, reliability engineering, electrical characterisation or yield analysis within a foundry, IDM or semiconductor R&D environment. Strong understanding of silicon CMOS fabrication processes, semiconductor device physics and foundry workflows. Hands-on experience with semiconductor parameter analysers, SMUs and wafer probe stations, including DC and/or RF electrical testing. Strong Python skills, particularly for instrument control, automation and automated test execution. A highly analytical approach and the ability to work with large datasets to identify trends, anomalies and root causes. Excellent communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across semiconductor, process, hardware and quantum engineering teams. Experience - Desirable It would be particularly valuable if you also have experience in: Quantum device physics, including quantum dots, single-electron transistors (SETs) or charge-stability mapping. Cryogenic electrical characterisation and low-temperature measurement systems. Semiconductor yield improvement, process control or statistical analysis. Automated wafer-level testing and high-throughput characterisation. Working with advanced or emerging semiconductor technologies. title: Manager, Agent Architecture
description: <h3><strong>About Parloa</strong></h3> <p>Parloa's mission is to make every customer conversation feel effortless for both customers and the companies serving them. As agentic AI accelerates, Parloans are shaping the foundation of a new era in customer experience, one where customer support is no longer transactions, but meaningful exchanges. It is not just a vision; Parloa has powered over ONE BILLION interactions between global enterprise brands and their customers, with companies like Booking.com, HealthEquity, Allianz, SAP, BarmeniaGothaer, and TUI already deploying Parloa at scale.</p> <h3><strong>About the role:</strong></h3> <p>As <strong>Manager, Agent Architecture</strong>, you will build and lead the team that transforms customer service with AI Agents, while staying in the build yourself. You run a team of Agent Architects: you hire them, coach them, set their goals, and own the quality of every AI Agent they ship, with a significant portion of your capacity on live customer engagements.</p> <p>This is your opportunity to lead at the front line of enterprise AI, where your credibility comes from doing the work alongside your team, not just directing it.</p> <h3><strong>Areas of ownership:</strong></h3> <ul> <li><strong>Team Leadership:</strong> Own hiring for Agent Architect roles, run weekly 1:1s, performance reviews, and career conversations, and build development plans that help each person grow. Set ramp expectations for new hires and coach Associate and mid-level Agent Architects on prompt engineering, conversation design, and customer-facing judgment.</li> <li><strong>Capacity and Stakeholder Alignment:</strong> Set team goals and OKRs aligned with Professional Services priorities, manage capacity and workload across concurrent engagements, and surface resourcing tradeoffs early. Represent the Agent Architecture team to Sales, Product, Engineering, customers, and partners.</li> <li><strong>Hands-on Agent Delivery:</strong> Personally guide customers through AI Agent implementations, from strategic advice to scoping to end-to-end delivery. Serve as the escalation point when agent performance degrades.</li> <li><strong>Quality and Best Practices:</strong> Define what good looks like for agent quality, enforce it through review, and make it repeatable across every live project. Document best practices for internal and external audiences, and turn recurring field problems into structured feedback for Product.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Who you are:</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Experience leading people, whether as a formal manager, team lead, or through sustained mentorship where you owned a group's growth and output. First-time managers with a strong coaching track record are welcome.</li> <li>3+ years of conversation design and AI agent development experience, with a track record of building scalable solution architecture and conversational experiences grounded in real user needs.</li> <li>Skilled in advanced prompt engineering, comfortable integrating REST APIs and working with Javascript.</li> <li>Strong project and stakeholder management skills, with significant experience working with enterprise customers, including in escalated or high-pressure situations.</li> <li>Sound judgment on capacity and prioritization: you can say what your team can and cannot absorb, and back it up with reasoning.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Our recruiting process:</strong></h3> <p>Talent Acquisition → Hiring Manager → Technical Interview(s) → Bar Raiser</p> <h3><strong>Why Parloa?</strong></h3> <p>We're at the beginning of a new era in customer experience, one where AI doesn't just respond, but understands, reasons, and takes action. We're building agentic AI that enterprises trust with their most important customer moments: complex questions, high volumes, real stakes. When millions of people reach out to a brand, those interactions aren't just support tickets; they're defining experiences. We're here to raise the standard: making every conversation seamless, intelligent, and genuinely helpful. If you care about shaping how businesses and customers connect at scale and want your work to matter in real, everyday moments, this is where you do it.</p> <p>At Parloa, ownership isn't a buzzword; it means being accountable for outcomes, not just tasks. We operate in a category that's evolving fast, where the bar is high, and the problems are complex. We hire people who think in solutions, communicate with clarity, and follow through. People who are comfortable making decisions, taking responsibility, and raising the standard for themselves and those around them.</p> <p>We've grown beyond the earliest startup phase, but we've kept the intensity: fast execution, direct feedback, and a strong expectation to contribute meaningfully from day one.</p> <p>Backed by leading global investors like General Catalyst, EQT Ventures, and Altimeter Capital, we're scaling with a clear ambition: to become the global category leader in enterprise-grade conversational AI.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><iframe style="display: table; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto;" src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/P4d-iyx7RQM" width="560" height="314"></iframe></p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <hr> <p>Parloa is committed to upholding the highest data protection standards for our clients' and employees' data. All our employees are instrumental in ensuring the utmost care, GDPR, and ISO compliance, including ISO 27001, in handling sensitive information.</p> <p>Parloa is an e-verify employer in the USA. <a class="c-link" href="https://www.e-verify.gov/about-e-verify/what-is-e-verify" target="_blank" data-stringify-link="https://www.e-verify.gov/about-e-verify/what-is-e-verify" data-sk="tooltip_parent">Please click here to learn more</a>.</p> <p><strong>* </strong><strong>We provide equal opportunities to all qualified applicants regardless race, gender, sexual orientation, age, religion, national origin, disability status, socioeconomic background and other characteristics.</strong></p></div> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Applied AI Architect, Beneficial Deployments (Life Sciences)
description: <div class="content-intro"><h2><strong>About Anthropic</strong></h2> <p>Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.</p></div><h2><strong>About Anthropic</strong></h2> <p>Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.</p> <h2><strong>About Beneficial Deployments</strong></h2> <p>Beneficial Deployments ensures AI reaches and benefits the communities that need it most. We partner with nonprofits, foundations, and mission-driven organizations to deploy Claude in education, global health, economic mobility, and life sciences, focusing on raising the floor.</p> <h2><strong>About the Role</strong></h2> <p>We're looking for an Applied AI Architect to join Beneficial Deployments, focused on maximizing the impact of Claude in the life sciences. Our goal is ambitious: accelerate scientific progress from R&amp;D through translation by an order of magnitude. That means making Claude the go-to tool for the life sciences ecosystem, from early discovery in academia to paradigm-shifting biotech to reimagining pharma pipelines.</p> <p>This role combines technical expertise with deep relationship-building. You'll be the primary technical advisor for our life sciences partners, including flagship research institutions like The Howard Hughes Medical Institute (HHMI) and The Allen Institute. You'll drive engagements from discovery through deployment, working closely with the life sciences segment lead and Applied AI Engineers to deliver impact. This role will be part of the founding Beneficial Deployments Applied AI team focused on bringing life sciences closer to the frontier.</p> <h2><strong>Responsibilities</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Serve as the primary technical advisor to life sciences research institutions and mission-driven organizations throughout their Claude adoption journey. Partner with the segment lead to understand scientific workflows end-to-end and translate them into impactful solutions from discovery through deployment.</li> <li>Transform partners into AI-native organizations through Claude Code and Claude Science enablements and research and business process evolution, so they can operate more effectively and build for where AI capabilities are headed.</li> <li>Design and lead cohort-based accelerators to scale our expertise and impact across multiple institutions at once.<br>Identify what's actually hard about deploying AI in life sciences and feed those findings back to product, engineering, and research.</li> <li>Spot patterns across partners to inform what we build at the ecosystem level, including MCP servers for domain-specific data sources, scientifically grounded benchmarks and evals, and reusable agent skills.</li> <li>Create technical presentations, demos, and scalable content (documentation, tutorials, sample code) so what works for one institution can scale globally without the same level of hand-holding.</li> <li>Travel occasionally to partner sites for workshops, technical deep dives, and relationship building.</li> <li>Help shape team processes and culture as we scale from 1 to N.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>You Might Be a Good Fit If You Have</strong></h2> <ul> <li>8+ years in a technical role, ideally with customer-facing exposure (Solutions Architect, Customer Engineer, Sales Engineer, Technical Account Manager, Product Engineer, Forward Deployed Engineer)</li> <li>Experience in life sciences, biomedical research, or scientific computing. Bonus if you've worked in genomics, neuroscience, or drug discovery specifically and are comfortable getting deeply technical with academics.</li> <li>Experience working in or building trust with academic research institutions, biotech, pharma, or other mission-driven scientific organizations, and an understanding of their unique challenges and constraints</li> <li>Familiarity with common LLM implementation patterns, including prompt and context engineering, evaluation frameworks, agent architectures, and retrieval frameworks</li> <li>A love of teaching, mentoring, and helping others succeed</li> <li>A scrappy mentality: comfortable wearing multiple hats, building from scratch, driving clarity in ambiguous situations, and doing whatever it takes to further the mission</li> </ul><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p>The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.&nbsp;</p> <p>For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.</p></div><div class="title">Annual Salary:</div><div class="pay-range"><span>£165,000</span><span class="divider">&mdash;</span><span>£190,000 GBP</span></div></div></div><div class="content-conclusion"><h2><strong>Logistics</strong></h2> <p><strong>Minimum education: </strong>Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience</p> <p><strong>Required field of study:&nbsp;</strong>A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience</p> <p><strong>Minimum years of experience: </strong>Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position</p> <p><strong>Location-based hybrid policy:</strong> Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.</p> <p><strong data-stringify-type="bold">Visa sponsorship:</strong>&nbsp;We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.</p> <p><strong>We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification.</strong> Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed.&nbsp; Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.<br><br><strong data-stringify-type="bold">Your safety matters to us.</strong> To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you ----- addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit&nbsp;<u data-stringify-type="underline"><a class="c-link c-link--underline" href="http://anthropic.com/careers" target="_blank" data-stringify-link="http://anthropic.com/careers" data-sk="tooltip_parent" data-remove-tab-index="true">anthropic.com/careers</a></u>&nbsp;directly for confirmed position openings.</p> <h2><strong>How we're different</strong></h2> <p>We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.</p> <p>The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI &amp; Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.</p> <h2><strong>Come work with us!</strong></h2> <p>Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. <strong data-stringify-type="bold">Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage:</strong>&nbsp;Learn about&nbsp;<a class="c-link" href="https://www.anthropic.com/candidate-ai-guidance" target="_blank" data-stringify-link="https://www.anthropic.com/candidate-ai-guidance" data-sk="tooltip_parent">our policy</a> for using AI in our application process.</p></div> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we’re building the delivery of (almost) everything and you’ll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.<br><br>Working at Wolt isn’t always easy, but it’s definitely exciting. Here you’ll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You’ll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you’re a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.</span></p></div><h2><strong>About the Team</strong></h2> <p>The Core BI team at DoorDash builds and operates the services, integrations and automation that power business intelligence across DoorDash, Deliveroo and Wolt. Our platforms help analysts, Analytics Engineers, Data Scientists, Software Engineers and business teams discover trusted data and make informed decisions at scale.</p> <p>We combine software engineering, platform ownership, and a strong user focus to make BI tooling reliable, secure, scalable and self-service. The team supports the current BI ecosystem while helping shape a more integrated experience across the DoorDash group.</p> <h2><strong>About the Role</strong></h2> <p>As a Software Engineer on the Core BI team, you will build and operate the backend services, APIs and infrastructure our BI platforms run on. BI is the domain you serve (primarily Looker and Sigma, and the systems around them), but the problems are backend and platform problems.</p> <p>You will own problems from discovery through design, implementation, deployment, and operational support. If you're energized by solving technical problems with data and comfortable being deeply embedded across several domains, this role is for you!</p> <h2><strong>You’re excited about this opportunity because you will…</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Design, build, test, deploy and operate the backend services, APIs and automation that the BI platforms across DoorDash, Deliveroo and Wolt depend on</li> <li>Automate the platform lifecycle end to end (provisioning, metadata, permissions, migrations, archival and validation) so administration stops being manual work</li> <li>Build the integrations between BI platforms and the wider ecosystem: warehouses, identity providers, orchestration, CI/CD and internal developer tooling</li> <li>Improve the availability, observability, performance, scalability and security of the systems you own, and carry them in production</li> <li>Use AI tooling as part of how you engineer, and where it fits, build LLM-backed capabilities held to the same reliability and governance bar as anything else we ship</li> <li>Raise the engineering bar on the team, from service design and code review to testing, CI/CD and documentation, and improve the developer experience for everyone building on the platform</li> </ul> <h2><strong>We’re excited about you because…</strong></h2> <ul> <li>3+ years of professional software engineering experience building and operating production backend, platform or infrastructure systems</li> <li>Readable, maintainable, well-tested code in Python, plus comfort with SQL and a working understanding of data modelling and warehousing concepts</li> <li>Experience building and owning APIs, integrations or automation in production, with sound judgement on service boundaries, authentication, data contracts and failure modes</li> <li>Hands-on with CI/CD, containers and Kubernetes, observability, debugging and incident response, and you expect to operate what you build</li> <li>Hands-on experience using AI tools (LLMs, agentic workflows, AI-assisted development) as part of how you engineer, and judgement about where they help and where they do not</li> <li>End-to-end ownership of ambiguous problems, clear communication with technical and non-technical teams, and comfort self-organising in a fast-paced, distributed environment</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Nice to Have</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Experience owning or integrating with BI platforms such as Looker, Sigma or comparable tools, and familiarity with semantic layers such as LookML or dbt</li> <li>Experience automating identity and access through raw.title: Senior Legal Counsel - AI and Digital assets
raw.description:
At PPRO, we simplify access to local payments - providing a local payments platform that empowers giants like PayPal, Stripe, and Microsoft to connect with billions of consumers worldwide. We are on an ambitious, fast-paced mission to 3x our growth by 2028 - and we’re just getting started.

Our magic lies in our team of proud payments nerds. Spanning over 50 nationalities across 10+ global locations, our diverse cultures aren't a checklist; they are the competitive advantage driving our innovation. This is a people-first, high trust environment where you’ll have the autonomy to make a massive impact, own your work end-to-end, and grow through broad exposure, meaningful challenges, and continuous learning. We get things done, challenge respectfully, put the customer first, and recognise that our biggest successes are those we create as a team. If you’re ready to leave your footprint on global commerce, join us.
 
The Purpose:

We're looking for a senior lawyer who's just as comfortable with emerging technology as they are with regulation. As part of PPRO's legal team, you'll work alongside our Product Lead Counsel and stakeholders across product, engineering, treasury and commercial, plus our partners around the world.

You'll help our growing payments business tackle what's next: from stablecoins and other digital assets to agentic AI and new product launches. Your day-to-day spans regulatory horizon scanning, hands-on deal work and legal advice that keeps pace with fast-moving technology. Your work will span multiple jurisdictions and legal domains, from contract to payments regulation, and you'll bring genuine curiosity about how new technology actually works, not just how to regulate it.


What you’ll be doing:

  • Advising the business on the full product lifecycle, from the first idea through launch, as we build, launch and scale PPRO's payment products globally, including digital asset and stablecoin initiatives

  • Reviewing and negotiating commercial agreements, including partner agreements and contracts tied to new product development

  • Drafting and maintaining customer-facing legal documents for new products, including terms and conditions and disclosures for AI-driven features

  • Advising on the regulatory side of product features, the onboarding of new payment methods, and market expansion which may include cross-border data flows, data protection and privacy, and payment services regulation

  • Advising on the legal and regulatory questions raised by digital assets, including stablecoins: e-money and payment services classification, custody, cross-border transfer rules and emerging digital asset regimes

  • Acting as our go-to expert on AI, including agentic AI and associated liability, governance, data use, contracting for AI tools and the regulatory frameworks that are still taking shape

  • Horizon scanning for legal and regulatory developments, and assisting with the implementation of any subsequently required changes

  • Collaborating with the compliance and risk teams to embed legal thinking into PPRO's product lifecycle and go-to-market planning

  • Improving legal and governance processes at PPRO, including exploring how AI tools can make our own legal team work smarter

  • Advising the business on ad hoc legal questions, from IP to corporate law and disputes

  • Liaising with external counsel and turning their advice into something the wider business can interpret and implement


    • You’ll need to:

  • Be a UK or EU qualified lawyer with 8+ years experience in the financial services, payments and/or technology sector, with a strong mix of regulatory, privacy and commercial legal experience 

  • Bring genuine, hands-on experience with payments, digital assets, including stablecoins, plus real depth on how AI, including agentic AI, is reshaping products and regulation

  • Have a good working knowledge of financial regulation, including payment services regulation across the UK and EU

  • Have strong experience advising on data protection and privacy (UK GDPR, EU GDPR, cross-border data transfers)

  • Be genuinely comfortable with technology so you are able to get into the detail with engineers, ask the right questions and follow a technical conversation

  • Be comfortable working in ambiguity and to independently work out the mitigation, not just the risk

  • Be able to turn complex legal or technical issues into plain English

  • Have a strong sense of ownership and the drive to push complex legal matters through to completion

  • Bring an open, flexible, team-oriented approach, with excellent communication skills

    • What's in it for you?
     
    Hybrid working - We offer a hybrid structure with a 3 days / week on site expectation, so you can strike the balance between office and home working. In addition to our 28-day holiday allowance, we also provide a work from abroad policy, enabling employees to work remotely for up to another 30 days per year 
     
    Learning and Development - We offer a GBP 1,000 annual budget to support your professional growth—because investing in your development benefits us all. In addition, we provide leadership cafés, on-the-job training, and other opportunities to help you grow your skills and thrive in your role..
     
    Insurance - Because better safe than sorry - we want our employees to benefit from various insurances including a medical insurance (BUPA health care plan) and a 5% matching pension plan through Now Pensions.
     
    Enhance Family Leave - We understand the importance of family - that's why we offer enhanced family leave to support you during key life moments.
     
    Workplace Nursery Scheme - Save on childcare through salary exchange
     
    Gym membership - PPRO helps contribute towards the costs of your gym membership, supporting your physical fitness journey while easing the burden on your wallet
     
    Mental Health Platform - We’ve teamed up with a top well-being platform to provide one-on-one therapy, chat therapy, therapist-led courses, guided meditations, and more.
     
    Our HQ office on Procter Street, is a short walk from Holborn, Farringdon and Covent Garden so if you’re a foodie there’s plenty nearby. The office is befitting a tech business and is set up for cross team collaboration.
     
    Pet-friendly office- Because work is better with your paw-tners by your side
     
    Our Principles: 
     
    We get things done: We are courageous; we take ownership, make decisions and get things done.
     
    We act with trust and integrity: We listen first and challenge respectfully. We seek out and leverage diverse perspectives. We welcome and offer honest and open feedback, always assuming positive intent
     
    We put the customer first: We are laser focused on delivering outstanding outcomes for our customers. We put the customer at the heart of what we do.

Scaling: Proactively recruit, onboard, and retain elite commercial and defense-domain talent to build a solid talent bench as the regional footprint expands.</li> <li>Cross-Functional Matrix Alignment: Orchestrate seamless collaboration across internal matrix teams including Government Affairs, Product, Engineering, and Field Marketing to align corporate capabilities with regional market opportunities.</li> <li>Technical &amp; Post-Sales Win Alignment: Partner closely with Pre-Sales/Solutions Engineering to secure technical wins, and collaborate with Post-Sales teams to ensure flawless customer onboarding, retention, and long-term expansion.</li> <li>Deal Cadence &amp; background-color: #f8f8f8;">Professional working proficiency in English, the language of the company.</span></li> </ul> <p><strong>What Makes You Stand Out:</strong></p> <ul> <li>5+ years of progressive sales leadership and enterprise business development experience within the defense, national security, or government technology sectors, with a track record of building high-performing teams and consistently exceeding revenue targets.</li> <li>Operational understanding of NATO defense priorities, Nordic security dynamics, joint acquisition processes, and agency decision-making across Allied Ministries of Defense and Tier-1 Defense Primes.</li> <li>Experience managing complex, multi-year deal cycles, with the ability to lead sales teams through disciplined capture frameworks, pipeline governance, and accurate revenue forecasting.</li> <li>Professional proficiency in a Nordic language (Swedish, Finnish, Norwegian, Danish) is a plus for engaging senior government ministers, military command leadership, and internal executives.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Application Deadline:</strong></p> <p>December 8, 2026 at 11:59p PT</p> <p><strong>Export Control Requirements:</strong></p> <p><em>Planet Labs Germany GmbH is authorized to receive U.S. export-controlled information at Planet under an export license issued by the Bureau of Industry and Security.
