raw.title: Senior Recruiting Coordinator (R5646)
raw.description:
Shield AI is a venture-backed defense-tech company with the mission of protecting service members and civilians with intelligent systems. Its products include Hivemind autonomy software, V-BAT and X-BAT aircraft, and Aechelon simulation and synthetic reality technologies. With offices and facilities across the U.S., Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific, Shield AI’s technology actively supports operations worldwide. For more information, visit www.shield.ai. Follow Shield AI on LinkedIn, X, Instagram, and YouTube. 

The Senior Recruiting Coordinator – EMEA is an individual contributor responsible for providing high-level operational and administrative support to the Talent Acquisition function, with primary ownership of complex interview scheduling, candidate travel coordination, and recruiting operations across EMEA.

This role independently manages high-volume and complex interview logistics across multiple countries, time zones, and stakeholder groups while delivering a seamless and high-touch candidate experience. The Recruiting Coordinator partners closely with recruiters, hiring managers, executives, and cross-functional teams to anticipate and resolve coordination challenges and support the successful execution of global hiring initiatives.

As an experienced member of the Talent Acquisition team, this role also serves as a resource for recruiting coordination best practices, identifies opportunities to improve operational processes, and helps establish scalable and consistent ways of working as the organization grows.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

Interview Coordination

  • Independently manage high-volume and complex interview scheduling across multiple countries and global time zones
  • Coordinate complex calendars involving candidates, interview panels, hiring managers, executives, and other key stakeholders
  • Arrange virtual and in-person interviews, including multi-stage and multi-day interview processes
  • Anticipate scheduling constraints and proactively identify solutions to minimize delays and ensure an efficient hiring process
  • Prepare and distribute accurate interview confirmations, calendar invitations, interview schedules, and relevant materials
  • Manage last-minute scheduling changes and competing priorities with professionalism, urgency, and sound judgment
  • Ensure interview details and candidate activity are accurately maintained within Talent Acquisition systems
  • Partner with recruiters and hiring teams to determine effective scheduling approaches for complex or business-critical searches
  • Serve as a resource to the Talent Acquisition team on interview coordination practices and processes

Candidate Travel & Logistics

  • Independently coordinate domestic and international candidate travel, including flights and accommodations
  • Prepare and distribute detailed candidate itineraries and ensure candidates have the information necessary for a seamless interview experience
  • Coordinate complex or time-sensitive travel arrangements across multiple EMEA locations
  • Manage travel changes, cancellations, disruptions, and other unexpected issues while minimizing impact to candidates and interview teams
  • Ensure candidate travel arrangements comply with applicable company travel policies and budget guidelines
  • Partner with internal stakeholders and external vendors, as appropriate, to resolve travel and logistical issues
  • Identify opportunities to improve candidate travel processes, documentation, and operational consistency

Candidate Experience

  • Serve as a primary point of contact for candidates throughout the interview process, providing timely, professional, and high-touch support
  • Deliver clear and proactive communication to candidates across multiple countries and time zones
  • Anticipate candidate questions and logistical needs and proactively address issues that could affect the interview experience
  • Ensure a consistent, organized, and positive candidate experience throughout all stages of interview coordination
  • Exercise discretion and professionalism when supporting sensitive, confidential, executive, or business-critical searches
  • Partner with recruiters and hiring teams to continuously improve the candidate experience

Recruiting Operations Support

  • Maintain accurate, complete, and timely candidate and interview data within Applicant Tracking Systems and other Talent Acquisition tools
  • Support recruiting metrics, reporting, audits, and operational tracking as needed
  • Monitor coordination workflows and identify opportunities to improve efficiency, accuracy, scalability, and stakeholder experience
  • Recommend and support implementation of improvements to scheduling, candidate travel, documentation, and recruiting coordination processes
  • Develop and maintain recruiting coordination resources, documentation, templates, and standard operating procedures
  • Support adoption of recruiting tools, processes, and operational best practices across the Talent Acquisition organization
  • Serve as a knowledgeable resource for recruiting coordination processes and provide guidance to recruiters, coordinators, and hiring teams as needed
  • Support onboarding and mentoring of recruiting coordinators or other Talent Acquisition team members, as appropriate
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Talent Acquisition, PX, Finance, hiring teams, and other business partners to support hiring initiatives
  • Support special projects and evolving Talent Acquisition priorities as the organization scales

Basic Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in recruiting coordination, Talent Acquisition operations, HR/PX operations, or a related role, including experience independently managing complex recruiting logistics
  • Demonstrated experience coordinating high-volume and complex interview schedules across multiple countries, time zones, and seniority levels
  • Experience managing complex calendars and interview logistics involving candidates, hiring managers, executives, and cross-functional stakeholders
  • Experience coordinating domestic and international candidate travel, including flights, accommodations, ground transportation, itinerary changes, and travel disruptions
  • Strong working knowledge of Applicant Tracking Systems, scheduling tools, and standard workplace productivity and collaboration platforms
  • Demonstrated ability to independently prioritize competing requests, anticipate issues, and resolve complex scheduling and logistical challenges
  • Strong organizational and project coordination skills with exceptional attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with demonstrated ability to communicate effectively with candidates and stakeholders at all levels
  • Demonstrated ability to exercise sound judgment and discretion when handling confidential and sensitive information
  • Ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced, high-growth environment with changing priorities and deadlines
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with globally distributed teams and support recruiting activities across EMEA business hours, as required

Preferred Qualifications

  • 7+ years of experience in recruiting coordination, Talent Acquisition operations, or a related recruiting operations function
  • Experience supporting Talent Acquisition within a high-growth technology, aerospace, defense, engineering, or similarly complex organization
  • Demonstrated experience serving as a subject matter expert or senior resource for interview coordination, candidate logistics, or recruiting operations
  • Experience supporting executive, highly specialized, high-volume, or business-critical hiring
  • Experience identifying, developing, and implementing improvements to recruiting coordination processes and workflows
  • Experience developing standard operating procedures, process documentation, templates, or other scalable recruiting resources
  • Experience supporting recruiting activities across multiple EMEA countries and navigating regional differences in candidate logistics and hiring processes
  • Familiarity with international travel requirements, visa documentation, and corporate travel policies
  • Experience supporting recruiting metrics, reporting, data integrity, and operational tracking
  • Experience onboarding, mentoring, or providing guidance to recruiting coordinators or other Talent Acquisition team members
  • Experience working with modern Applicant Tracking Systems and recruiting technology ecosystems
  • European languages proficiency is a plus
 
Our international teammates receive a comprehensive total rewards package aligned to your country office location. For full details on compensation and benefits, please consult your talent acquisition partner.

emerging technologies and architectural approaches that could strengthen the Lab’s platform or unlock new capabilities.</li> <li>Help build the scalable data foundations Brunswick needs to develop and deploy AI responsibly, securely and effectively.</li> </ul> <h2>What We’re Looking For</h2> <p>You will combine strong data and solution architecture skills with a practical engineering mindset and the ability to operate in a fast-moving product environment. technical role.</li> <li>Strong experience designing scalable data and application architectures, ideally in cloud environments.</li> <li>Experience designing data models, APIs, integrations and data flows across databases, SaaS applications and enterprise systems.</li> <li>Strong knowledge of modern data architecture, including data modelling, ETL/ELT pipelines, storage, access patterns, data incorporating generative AI, large language models or machine learning.</li> <li>Designing data and integration architectures for AI applications, including retrieval and grounding approaches.</li> <li>Building internal developer platforms, shared services or reusable application frameworks.</li> <li>Working with sensitive enterprise data and complex security or governance requirements.</li> <li>Experience in professional services, financial services, advisory or another complex enterprise environment.</li> </ul> <h2>Why Join Us</h2> <p>Whether you are joining a client facing team, a core and continuous professional development.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><h1>About Brunswick</h1> <p>Brunswick is a global advisory firm. The main purpose of these correspondences and announcements is to obtain privileged information from individuals. </p> <p>Anaplan does not: &nbsp;</p> <ul> <li>Extend offers to candidates without an extensive interview process with a member of our recruitment team and a hiring manager via video or in person. &nbsp;</li> <li>Send job offers via email. All offers are first extended verbally by a member of our internal recruitment team whenever possible and then followed up via written communication. &nbsp;</li> </ul> <p>All emails from Anaplan would come from an ----- email address. title: Senior Product Manager, Search Infrastructure
description: <h3><strong><span data-ccp-props="{}">The role</span></strong></h3> <p>Tavily, part of Nebius, is the web access layer for AI agents. Over two million developers use us, and our customers include Fortune 500 companies running agents in production.</p> <p>We build and run our own index. That means we own the hard problems directly: crawl coverage at scale, freshness, cost per query, and the quality of what comes back. This role owns that infrastructure as a product.</p> <p>When an agent asks a question, the answer has to be relevant, fresh, fast, and affordable. Those four things pull against each other, and someone has to decide which one gives. That is you. You will set what good means for each use case we serve and the bar a change has to clear before it ships, working closely with our evaluation team, who own how we measure it. You will also shape where our index goes next: what it needs to cover, how fresh it needs to be, and what it has to be good at.</p> <p>The most open part of the job is what comes next. Search is being rebuilt for a consumer that is not a person. Agents do not want one result page, they want to break a problem apart, run many retrievals, and decide what to do next. That changes what search infrastructure should look like, and part of your job is to have a view on where ours should go.</p> <p>The hard part is deciding what good enough means. Perfect coverage, perfect freshness, and low cost cannot all be true at once, and the person in this seat is the one who has to make that call for each use case and defend it.</p> <p>In your first year, we expect you to set a clear quality bar for our search products that the team builds against, have a real influence on where our index goes next, and bring us a point of view on where search infrastructure is heading.</p> <p>This is a hands-on senior IC role with real ownership, reporting to the Director of Product. You will work day to day with our search engineering and research teams, with the evaluation team, and with customer success, who bring us quality feedback from real accounts every week. Our search engineers are deeply experienced in large-scale retrieval, and the product team is small, so you will argue your case directly with the people building it. That only works if you have built at this scale yourself.</p> <p><strong><span data-contrast="auto"><span data-ccp-charstyle="Strong">Your responsibilities will include:</span></span></strong><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;134233117&quot;:true,&quot;134233118&quot;:true}">&nbsp;</span></p> <ul> <li>Set the quality bar and release criteria for search: what good means per use case, and what a change has to clear before it ships. Our evaluation team owns the measurement, and you work closely with them on what to measure and why.</li> <li>Own the depth, latency, and cost tradeoffs across our search products, and make them explicit and defensible.</li> <li>Shape the direction of our index: what it needs to cover, how fresh it needs to be, and what quality bar it has to meet.</li> <li>Build a point of view on where search infrastructure is going as agents, rather than people, become the main consumer, and turn that into a roadmap.</li> <li>Know how we compare to the alternatives customers evaluate, and drive the work that closes the gaps that matter.</li> <li>Work with customer success and directly with customers to understand where our results fall short in real workflows, and turn that into quality priorities.</li> <li>Partner with the data and vertical product owners on what our corpus needs to contain and how results should be shaped per industry.</li> </ul> <p><strong><span data-contrast="auto"><span data-ccp-charstyle="Strong">We expect you to have:</span></span></strong><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;134233117&quot;:true,&quot;134233118&quot;:true}">&nbsp;</span></p> <ul> <li>5+ years of product management experience, with a meaningful portion spent on high-scale search or ranking systems: web search, feed ranking at a large social platform, or a large ad engine.</li> <li>A background as an engineer, ML engineer, or researcher on a production system in one of those areas. This is a requirement rather than a preference. You will be making tradeoff calls alongside senior search engineers, and you need to have built something at that scale yourself.</li> <li>Direct experience shipping a search or ranking change end to end, including how it was evaluated and what happened after it shipped.</li> <li>A strong data foundation: you can design an experiment, read eval results critically, and tell a real quality improvement from noise.</li> <li>Product judgment to match the technical depth: you can decide what to build and what to leave, and defend it to both engineers and customers.</li> <li>Strong understanding of LLMs, AI agents, and how retrieval fits into agentic workflows.</li> <li>Comfort with ambiguity, moving between strategy and execution without losing the thread.</li> <li>The ability to influence and align cross-functional stakeholders without formal authority.</li> </ul> <p><strong><span data-contrast="auto"><span data-ccp-charstyle="Strong">It will be an added bonus if you have:</span></span></strong><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;134233117&quot;:true,&quot;134233118&quot;:true}">&nbsp;<br></span></p> <ul> <li>Depth in information retrieval, NLP, or applied machine learning beyond what the role requires.</li> <li>Experience with index tiering, sharding, freshness pipelines, or cost-per-query optimisation at scale.</li> <li>Experience with hybrid retrieval, semantic and lexical search, re-ranking, or human evaluation programs.</li> <li>Experience in API-first or developer-platform businesses running both self-serve and enterprise motions.</li> <li>Experience in a high-growth technology company, especially post-acquisition or startup-within-a-larger-org environments.</li> </ul> <p><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;134233117&quot;:true,&quot;134233118&quot;:true}">&nbsp;</span></p> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

raw.description:
Step into a role where science meets strategy and your expertise shapes the future of drug development. As a Director, Pharmacometrician, you’ll lead high-impact modeling and simulation efforts within a dynamic Clinical Pharmacology, Modeling and Simulation (CPMS) environment. You’ll guide teams, mentor pharmacometricians, and provide strategic insight to clients at key development milestones. This role also offers the opportunity to represent clients in interactions with regulatory agencies. If you thrive on collaboration and solving complex scientific challenges, this is your chance to make a meaningful impact.

About the role

This role combines scientific leadership and strategic impact, leading population PK analyses while developing innovative approaches to improve efficiency and accuracy. You will design, analyze, and interpret clinical pharmacology studies, provide strategic guidance to clients, and contribute to regulatory documents and agency interactions. In addition, you’ll foster client relationships, support business development, and stay at the forefront of PK/PD advancements to drive continuous improvement.

Your main responsibilities will include but not limited to:

  • Lead and conduct population PK analyses using advanced modeling tools and methodologies
  • Develop and implement innovative approaches to enhance the efficiency and accuracy of PK analysis
  • Design, analyze, and interpret clinical pharmacology studies (renal, hepatic, TQT, ADME, DDI, BE/BA, SAD, MAD, etc.) and provide guidance to optimize pharmacokinetic sampling and dosing strategies  
  • Provide strategic guidance to clients, owning deliverables and developing clinical pharmacology plans
  • Author and review PK reports and clinical pharmacology sections of regulatory documents
  • Represent clients in regulatory interactions and contribute to business development and relationship management

Requirements

About You

If you are a driven clinical pharmacology professional with 6–10 years of experience in drug development and pharmacometrics and you bring sharp analytical thinking and expertise in tools like NONMEM, Pirana, and R to deliver high-impact insights while being client-focused and a natural leader who thrives in fast-paced environments, combining strategic thinking, strong communication, and business acumen to build relationships and drive results, this role is for you.

Du arbeitest eng mit dem Produkt-Team zusammen und übersetzt die Bedürfnisse unserer Käufer und Verkäufer in nachhaltige technische Lösungen.. raw.title: Content & Growth Marketing Specialist
raw.description:
About Dedale:

Dedale is the differentiating source of strategic intelligence in the technology space.

With a unique team of over 100 full-time research analysts & planners, Dedale leverages a network of over 10,000 market professionals to deliver on-the-ground strategic intelligence to investors and corporates, with a core focus around North America and Europe.

Our team gathers top talents with diverse and international backgrounds. Our Research & Investment team has the strongest expertise in the ecosystem on B2B Software due diligence, and we are surrounded by a network of mentors including high-profile tech founders and investors.

 

Our Culture:

Dedale gathers a group of highly talented international individuals (incl. US, Chinese, Filipino, French, Moroccan, Latvian, Lebanese nationalities among others).

The leadership team is composed of experienced investment professionals & management consultants (ex-McKinsey, BCG Project Leaders & managers).

Our advisory board is extremely high profile, including some of the most successful investors worldwide (incl. Managing Partners of the largest PE and Growth Equity funds, and Tech unicorn entrepreneurs).

We seek to develop a dream team of outstanding investment analysts with strong academic and professional achievements and a passion for investing and technology.

Your Opportunity

As a Content & Lead Generation Specialist, you will own the content-to-pipeline engine at Dedale. You will design, produce, distribute, and optimize all content that turns Dedale's intelligence into qualified leads — across our platform, LinkedIn, newsletters, gated reports, email sequences, and search. This is a builder role, not an executor role. You won't wait for briefs to write themselves: you will propose, test, iterate, and report. You will own your streams end-to-end, from editorial decisions to performance data, driving content that converts.

Your Responsibilities

1. Lead Generation Engine & Social Media

  • Manage the production calendar and pipeline for gated reports (2/month) and lead capture mechanics

  • Drive Dedale's LinkedIn presence (12 posts/month), writing, scheduling, and optimizing for engagement/CTR across company and leadership accounts

  • Write, segment, and monitor the monthly newsletter sent to our leads list

  • Design email sequences and community nurturing flows (segment logic, copy, deliverability) to build active, autonomous segments (PE, Corporate, Members)

  • Execute and monitor LinkedIn Ad campaigns based on strategy briefs

2. Editorial & Platform Content Ownership

  • Fully own the Tech Leaders interview series: outreach, production, platform publishing, and community follow-up, while experimenting with new formats and distribution tests

  • Build and manage the Super Experts stream: routing, editing, and publishing expert profiles

  • Support new strategic streams, including Talent Intelligence, Ask Dedale launch content, and dedicated US storytelling

  • Maintain employer branding initiatives and propose new ways to surface team culture

3. SEO, GEO & Website Optimization

  • Take full ownership of organic search performance, executing a strategic SEO/GEO audit and implementing a cluster content framework

  • Optimize on-page content, structured data, entity definitions, and visibility in AI-generated answers (GEO) to drive organic sessions

  • Drive lead capture optimization on the website, improving CTA placement, landing pages, and gated demo executions in Webflow

4. Event Support & Intelligence Capitalization

  • Manage pre-event briefs and post-event debriefs with Topic Leaders across key cluster events

  • Format and publish debrief outputs as intelligence pages on the platform

  • Support event logistics, promotion, and post-event content distribution

5. Performance Tracking & Strategic Insights

  • Track performance per campaign and stream, extracting data and delivering cross-channel reporting

  • Interpret performance metrics to surface actionable insights that continuously refine the overall marketing strategy

Your Profile

  • 1–2 years of relevant experience (including high-impact internships); proven ability to deliver results and work independently is what matters most

  • Proven track record of owning a B2B content stream end-to-end (from brief to reporting) for a senior, sophisticated audience (PE, Corporate Strategy, GovTech)

  • Strong written and verbal English (Dedale’s primary working and content language)

  • Solid SEO fundamentals (on-page optimization, keyword strategy, basic audits)

  • Proactive, organized, and autonomous by default — comfortable managing multiple workstreams and bringing fresh ideas to the table without waiting for direction

  • Strong cross-functional collaborator who thrives working alongside Sales, CS, Topic Leads, and Product

Nice-to-have:

  • Experience with email platforms (Brevo or similar) and Webflow/no-code CMS

  • Familiarity with LinkedIn Ads Manager and product analytics tools (PostHog, GA4, etc.)

  • Understanding of GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) / AI search visibility

  • Keen interest in financial markets, Private Equity, or institutional tech sectors

What you’ll learn

  • How to build and scale a high-converting, B2B lead generation engine from scratch

  • Advanced multi-channel distribution and executive personal branding techniques

  • Exposure to top-tier Private Equity, Tech, AI, and institutional investment communities

  • How to leverage cutting-edge growth frameworks (SEO/GEO, data-driven nurturing) working closely with senior leadership

What we offer

  • A high-impact role with true ownership and operational autonomy

  • Direct mentorship from the Marketing Lead and close collaboration with C-level executives

  • A fast-growing, expert-driven environment with a high-caliber international team

  • Office in Paris

Application process:

  1. Introduction Call with HR

  2. Interview with Hiring Manager (Marketing Lead)

  3. Case Study

  4. Final Interview with a member of the Leadership Team

title: Stage Master 2 : Elaboration de panneaux biosourcés à base de pailles
description: L'IMT Mines Alès, grande école de prestige qui se classe parmi les meilleures écoles d’ingénieurs sur le plan national et mondial et implantée à Alès, ville à taille humaine, capitale des Cévennes où la qualité de vie est fortement appréciée par ses habitants. Créée en 1843, IMT Mines Alès compte à ce jour 1400 élèves (dont 250 étrangers) et 380 personnels. L’école dispose de 3 centres de recherche et d’enseignement de haut niveau scientifique et technologique, qui œuvrent dans les domaines des matériaux et du génie civil (C2MA), de l’environnement et des risques (CREER), de l’intelligence artificielle et du génie industriel et numérique (CERIS). Elle dispose de 12 plateformes technologiques et compte 1600 entreprises partenaires. Pour en savoir plus : https://www.imt-mines-ales.fr Contexte : Le stage à pourvoir s’inscrit dans le cadre du projet européen Best-Crop impliquant 18 partenaires à l’échelle européenne : https://www.bestcrop.eu/ dont le but est de contribuer à développer l’économie circulaire en offrant de nouvelles variétés d’orge à rendement amélioré ( article de perspective – projet Best-Crop ). ). L’un des volets du projet consiste à fournir des pailles d’orge de composition et/ou structure optimisées pour différentes applications, dont, entre autres, le secteur de la construction (fabrication de panneaux de particules et de biocomposites). Dans le cadre de ce projet, l’équipe PCH a pour tâche d’étudier l’influence de la sélection et du fractionnement des pailles issues de différentes variétés d’orge, ainsi que d’étudier la microstructure et le comportement mécanique de panneaux biosourcés élaborés par pressage à chaud. Objectifs : Le stage consiste à mettre en œuvre des panneaux de pailles, d’optimiser le procédé de fabrication, et d’évaluer la variabilité des comportements mécaniques et d’isolation observés en regard de la composition et de la morphologie des pailles pour développer des panneaux performants. Le travail contribuera également à compléter la large base de données sur les panneaux à renforts lignocellulosiques développés au laboratoire. Vous trouverez davantage d’informations sur le stage ici : https://partage.imt.fr/index.php/s/nRzezN9XJz7gYLS Compétences et connaissances : Élève de formation BAC+5 (Master 2) en science et génie des matériaux polymères et composites Connaissances dans le domaine des biocomposites à fibres végétales Production scientifique (rédaction de publications, de posters, présentations orales ...) Conditions : Le stage est prévu pour une durée de 6 mois à partir de février 2027 Date limite de candidature : 20/11/2026 Un entretien d’environ 45 minutes (possible en visioconférence) pour discuter de votre parcours, de votre motivation, de vos compétences et de votre projet professionnel. Vous devrez transmettre un dossier comprenant :     CV détaillé     Lettre de motivation expliquant votre intérêt pour le sujet et vos compétences     Relevés de notes M1 et M2 (ou équivalent) Contacts : Clément LACOSTE, Enseignant-chercheur, Nicolas LE MOIGNE, Enseignant-chercheur, Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

title: CENTRALE LYON ENISE - Post doctorat - Modélisation et optimisation de la sphéroïdisation de poudres métalliques par plasma RF
description: Le poste est basé à Centrale Lyon ENISE, sur le campus stéphanois, qui accueille plus de 1250 élèves et 160 personnels, dans un environnement exceptionnel aux portes du Pilat. Centrale Lyon ENISE forme des ingénieurs de spécialité Génie mécanique, Génie civil, Génie sensoriel sous statut étudiant (FISE) ou sous statut apprenti (FISA). DESCRIPTIF Contexte scientifique : Dans le cadre d'un projet ANR consacré au traitement et à la fonctionnalisation de poudres métalliques par plasma radiofréquence, le laboratoire souhaite recruter un post-doc pour développer une approche couplant modélisation physique, expérimentation et optimisation des paramètres de procédé. Le travail portera principalement sur la sphéroïdisation de poudres d'AlSi10Mg par plasma RF inductif, réalisée sur une torche TekSphero40 (40 kW). Le procédé vise à transformer des particules initialement irrégulières en particules sphériques adaptées notamment aux procédés de fabrication additive métallique. Le projet s'intéresse à un problème scientifique fortement couplé. L'augmentation de l'énergie apportée aux particules favorise leur fusion et leur sphéroïdisation, mais peut simultanément accentuer l'évaporation du magnésium, la formation de nanoparticules et la coalescence des particules en vol. L'objectif est donc de rechercher un compromis optimal entre plusieurs critères de qualité de la poudre. Verrous scientifiques : La fabrication additive métallique par fusion laser sur lit de poudre (L-PBF) nécessite des poudres très sphériques, coulables et chimiquement homogènes. Le procédé de sphéroïdisation par plasma à couplage inductif radiofréquence (RF) est une voie industrielle intéressante pour répondre à ces besoins. Dans ce procédé, la poudre traverse un plasma d'argon à 10 000 K, fond en vol (~ 5 -150 ms) et se resolidifie en gouttelette sphérique sous l'effet de la tension de surface. La qualité finale des poudres dépend de quatre paramètres opératoires principaux : la puissance du procédé, le débit de poudre, les débits de gaz (central, gaine, porteur), et la position axiale de la sonde d'injection de poudre dans le plasma. Sur la torche TekSphero40 (20-40 kW) et pour l'AlSi10Mg, trois verrous scientifiques sont identifiés et doivent être levés simultanément : • Verrou 1 : Coalescence des particules : les gouttelettes fondues, en raison de leur faible viscosité, fusionnent lors de collisions en vol, provoquant un grossissement non contrôlé de la distribution granulométrique. Ceci a été particulièrement observé dans nos essais sur la sphéroïdisation de AlSi10Mg. Dans la littérature, cet effet a été rapporté sur une poudre de tungstène (Zhu et al. 2017). • Verrou 2 : Évaporation des éléments légers : le magnésium (Tvap = 1091 °C) s'évapore préférentiellement dans le plasma, provoquant un appauvrissement en Mg de l'alliage (perte de la phase durcissante Mg₂Si) et la formation de fumées métalliques. • Verrou 3 : Formation de nanoparticules : les vapeurs métalliques produite dans le plasma conduisent à la condensation en nanoparticules polluantes et parfois, de dépôts satellites sur les grosses particules. Ces trois verrous sont couplés : augmenter la puissance ou le temps de séjour améliore la sphéricité mais aggrave la coalescence et l'évaporation. Le problème est intrinsèquement multi-objectifs et aucune solution "toute faite" n'existe dans la littérature pour cet alliage. MISSION ET ACTIVITES Le post-doc développera un modèle permettant de prédire le comportement des particules dans le plasma en considérant trois phénomènes physiques principaux : • Fusion et sphéroïdisation : établir le bilan énergétique entre le plasma et les particules afin de déterminer les conditions permettant leur fusion complète et leur transformation en particules sphériques. • Évaporation du magnésium : modéliser la perte préférentielle de Mg lorsque les particules atteignent des températures élevées, en reliant température, temps de séjour et cinétique d'évaporation. • Coalescence : étudier les collisions et la fusion entre particules en vol afin de prédire leur évolution granulométrique. Ces trois phénomènes seront ensuite couplés dans une approche d'optimisation multi-objectifs, afin d'identifier les conditions permettant de maximiser la sphéroïdisation tout en limitant la perte de Mg, la formation de nanoparticules et l'élargissement de la distribution granulométrique. Le travail comportera une forte interaction entre modélisation et expérimentation. Les prédictions seront confrontées à des essais réalisés sur la TekSphero-40 et à la caractérisation des poudres par MEB, diffraction laser, mesure de densité apparente et ICP-AES. Un plan d'expériences sera notamment utilisé pour calibrer et valider les modèles. Activités principales : 1.Acquérir des connaissances sur le procédé de sphéroïdisation plasma RF 2.Développer les modèles physiques 3. Développer une approche de modélisation numérique 4. Mettre en œuvre une stratégie d'optimisation 5.Conduire et analyser les expérimentations Diplôme requis pour les contractuels : doctorat Spécialité/domaine (facultatif) : génie des procédés, génie mécanique, science et génie des matériaux, métallurgie, physique des plasmas, thermique et énergétique, mécanique des fluides ou domaine scientifique proche. Une expérience directe en plasma thermique ou en sphéroïdisation de poudres serait appréciée, mais elle n'est pas indispensable. Le candidat devra surtout posséder une solide formation scientifique lui permettant d'acquérir rapidement les connaissances spécifiques au procédé. Connaissances : Le/la candidat(e) devra disposer de bonnes bases dans plusieurs des domaines suivants : transferts thermiques, thermodynamique, mécanique des fluides, phénomènes de transport, science des matériaux et métallurgie, modélisation physique, méthodes numériques, statistiques et plans d'expériences. Une bonne compréhension des phénomènes de changement de phase, de transfert de chaleur, de transport de matière et de cinétique est particulièrement recherchée. Le projet nécessite également une capacité à passer d'une description physique du phénomène à un modèle mathématique exploitable numériquement. Savoir-être : Nous recherchons un(e) jeune chercheur(se) autonome, curieux(se) et capable d'aborder un problème physique complexe, de formuler des hypothèses, de développer un modèle, de le confronter à l'expérience et de l'améliorer sur la base des résultats obtenus. Le poste offre la possibilité de travailler à l'interface de plusieurs domaines : Plasma RF → Transferts thermiques → Métallurgie des poudres → Modélisation → Expérimentation → Optimisation → Fabrication additive. Cycle hebdomadaire de 37,30 H - 48,5 jours de congés - aménagement possible du temps de travail sur 4,5 jours - télétravail sous conditions. Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

raw.title: SRE Manager
raw.description:
About Us

Parity is one of the world's most experienced core blockchain infrastructure companies, having built and pioneered some of the most advanced technologies in the blockchain sector. Parity was founded by Dr. Gavin Wood, co-founder and former CTO of Ethereum, the primary engineer behind the Ethereum Virtual Machine (EVM), inventor of the Solidity programming language, and primary author of the Ethereum Yellowpaper.

People in Our Collective Are

  • Highly motivated to contribute to Parity’s mission and be part of something bigger

  • Excited to work on projects that are groundbreaking and complex

  • Autonomous workers that self-initiate, but also collaborate well with others

  • Taking maximum accountability and having minimum ego at work

  • Comfortable with chaos and adapting to the ever-changing Web3 space

  • Continuously educating themselves about Parity and the wider ecosystem

About the Team

The SRE team is responsible for the infrastructure that makes the Polkadot platform and technology work: test and production network environments, deployment pipelines, observability, and the systems that developers, node operators, and end-user applications across the ecosystem rely on. This spans the full stack from runtime and parachain development environments through to infrastructure supporting live applications and events.

We run environments at different stability tiers, from fast-moving test networks with daily automated updates to production networks with 24/7 on-call coverage. It's a small team, so the role carries broad scope.

The Role

We're looking for an engineering manager who can lead a team of experienced SRE engineers and raise the standard of what reliability looks like in a blockchain infrastructure context.

The team is technically capable. What it needs is someone who can set engineering direction, build the conditions for good work, and think clearly about reliability as a discipline: SLOs, error budgets, blameless postmortems.

What We're Looking For

Systems thinking. You have a genuine understanding of distributed systems and large-scale infrastructure. You don't need to be the most senior engineer technically, but you need to be credible to people who are.

Reliability. You've worked in or led a team that takes SRE seriously. You know what error budgets are actually for, when SLOs are miscalibrated, and how to run postmortems that improve things.

Automation. You get uncomfortable when skilled engineers spend time on work a machine could do. You've built teams that automate away the repetitive work rather than just absorbing it.

People development. You have a track record of engineers growing under your leadership, ideally some of them moving on to bigger things.

Comfort with unusual territory. Blockchain infrastructure has properties that don't map cleanly onto standard cloud operations. You don't need prior Web3 experience, but you shouldn't be put off by it either.

Working at Parity

Remote-first, with offices in Berlin, Lisbon, and London. Parity is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome diversity in our global team and care about everyone in our collective feeling included and welcome.

View our Applicant Notice to see how we use your data.

Is this position not quite your match? Browse our other open roles.

raw.description:
Company & Role Overview 

About Hilo by Aktiia 

High blood pressure is the world's most common disease, causing 18M deaths each year. At Hilo by Aktiia, we're building a world where no lives are lost to its effects — with technology that helps people take control of their health. 

We're a venture-backed scale-up with $96M raised from investors in Europe and the US. Rooted in 18 years of research at the Swiss Center for Electronics and Microtechnology (CSEM), our device is the world's only medically accurate, cuffless, continuous blood pressure monitor for daily use — clinically validated and CE Marked as a Class IIa medical device, now available in 12 countries. In July, we launched in the US. 

We're a remote-first company headquartered in Neuchâtel, Switzerland, united by our passion for impact and innovation. 

Role overview

As Post-Market Surveillance Manager, you'll build and run our global post-market surveillance system — from complaint handling and adverse-event reporting to data trending and governance — and lead its rollout across Customer Support, QA, Regulatory, Engineering, Clinical, and Product. This is a hands-on role: you'll turn post-market insights into action that improves product quality, patient safety, and the customer experience, drawing on strong judgment, disciplined execution, and the ability to influence stakeholders globally. 

Requirements

Core responsibilities

  • Design, build, and run our global post-market surveillance system — complaint handling, adverse-event/vigilance reporting, escalation, and governance — staying hands-on for complex or high-risk cases
  • Own the complaint-to-report pipeline: reportability assessments and timely, accurate adverse-event/vigilance submissions across markets (US, EU, and others)
  • Build the KPIs, dashboards, and trending methods that surface safety, quality, and customer-experience signals — and turn findings into action via CAPA, risk management, product/software fixes, and labeling updates
  • Lead the cross-functional rollout — implementation plans, priorities, dependencies, and risk — to build sustainable post-market processes and infrastructure
  • Present post-market performance and recommendations to leadership, and support PMS reports, PSURs, and management reviews 
  • Act as SME during audits and inspections, and guide internal teams and external partners on post-market activities 

Background & Experience

  • 7+ years in medical-device post-market surveillance, complaint handling, quality, or regulatory affairs, including leading process implementations 
  • At least a bachelor's degree
  • Hands-on experience with complaint investigations, reportability assessments, and regulatory submissions (FDA MDR, EU MDR vigilance/PMS, ISO 13485, ISO 14971), plus post-market data analysis
  • Program management skills — workstreams, stakeholders, dependencies — plus an analytical mindset for turning complaint data into risk-based recommendations 
  • Strong communicator, comfortable influencing cross-functional teams, leadership, and regulators
  • Hands-on, independent leadership style; able to scale processes as we grow
  • Nice to have: experience with additional international markets or digital complaint-management systems

What success looks like

  • Scalable processes for complaint intake, investigation, and resolution — with clear escalation pathways to ensure adverse events and reportable incidents are identified, assessed, and reported within regulatory timeline
  • Customer Support consistently identifies, documents, and escalates complaints and potential safety events, thanks to close partnership and training
  • KPIs and dashboards give clear visibility into complaint timeliness, resolution, regulatory reporting, and emerging trends
  • Post-market insights translate into action — product improvements, CAPAs, risk-management updates, and a better customer experience

Benefits

What Makes You A Great Fit

At Hilo by Aktiia, our values guide everything we do: 

Move the Needle — You focus on what drives real impact. You let data and clarity guide your decisions, and you take accountability for results. You're a difference maker — you drive ideas to commercial success from start to end 

Move Fast, Learn, Refine — You work with urgency and purpose, balancing speed with quality. You treat feedback as a chance to learn, and you're deep in customer and partner feedback — translating it to action quickly

Team First — You collaborate effectively across teams and build trust through clarity and respect. You're comfortable bridging local execution with a global team, and you communicate openly across time zones

Why Join Us?

  • Hilo by Aktiia is becoming one of the most important med-tech companies, and you can be part of this exciting story
  • Work on a mission that matters: transforming cardiovascular health at global scale
  • Be part of a high-impact, fast-growing, and venture-backed scale-up company
  • Collaborate with a diverse, passionate, and talented team
  • Competitive compensation and equity program, and other benefits (depending on location)

Ready to Move the Needle?

If you are passionate about making a meaningful impact in people's lives and excel in an environment where individuals take ownership and are committed to delivering results, we are happy to receive your application.

description: <h1><span style="font-size: 14pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><strong>About Upsun (formerly Platform.sh)&nbsp;</strong></span></h1> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Upsun is the cloud application platform humans and robots love. It is built for today’s hybrid teams, where AI agents write and test code and humans focus on solving the problems that really matter. Developers, DevOps engineers, and platform teams use Upsun to build, ship, and scale confidently without wrestling with backend infrastructure. We give you your time back. You get:</span></p> <ul> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Predictable performance, even at scale </span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Secure, compliant environments by default&nbsp;</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Real-time observability and profiling built in </span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Cloning, configuration, and provisioning in seconds&nbsp;</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">AI-ready features that plug directly into your stack </span></li> </ul> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;">The name says it all. "Up" means uptime, reliability, and acceleration. "Sun" reflects our follow-the-sun-support, a 24x7, globally distributed support team keeping the lights on while you rest. Our core belief is that software should power brighter solutions and greater innovation. </span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Upsunners are a remote, global workforce, and we thrive in a multicultural team. We are committed to open source and an open, welcoming environment. Our team spans the globe and the experience spectrum. </span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;">What's our commonality, our cultural fabric? A curious spirit and a thirst for knowledge; an eagerness for innovative ideas and cultures. We believe we can build anything together in an environment that frees you to do your best work. </span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Our values:&nbsp;</span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;">🌿 We make a positive impact.</span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;">✨ We aim for the stars.</span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;">💚 We care for each other.&nbsp;</span></p> <h1><span style="font-size: 14pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><strong>Impact of a Product Manager</strong></span></h1> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;">As a Product Manager at Upsun, you own a significant area of Upsun Cloud, our cloud application platform, and the outcomes it delivers for the developers who build on it. The team you join owns the platform's foundations: the API, the runtime, environments, and the reliability every application running on Upsun depends on. And because Upsun is the cloud application platform humans and robots love, much of what you build will be used by AI agents as much as by people.</span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;">This is a hands-on, technically rich role that bridges product strategy and deep infrastructure understanding. You own the strategy and the roadmap for your area, working closely with engineering to define platform behavior, build scalable abstractions, and shape workflows that empower modern development teams. Throughout, you act as the key voice for the user, making sure everything we ship contributes meaningfully to an exceptional developer experience.</span></p> <h1><span style="font-size: 14pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><strong>What to expect</strong></span></h1> <ul> <li> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>Strategy and roadmap:</strong> Own the strategy, roadmap, and priorities for your area of Upsun Cloud, balancing established foundations with uncharted territory.</span></p> </li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>Problem definition:</strong> Synthesize inputs from customers, support, sales, and engineering into clear problem statements, constructively testing underlying assumptions.</span></p> </li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>Solution definition:</strong> Explore options with your team, weigh trade-offs, and land on the right scope.</span></p> </li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>Ship small, iterate fast:</strong> Release in increments and shorten the loop between shipping and learning.</span></p> </li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>Technical execution:</strong> Collaborate with engineering (especially infrastructure and systems teams) to deliver platform capabilities that are reliable, scalable, and developer-friendly.</span></p> </li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>Design for humans and agents:</strong> Build with two audiences in mind—ensuring features, APIs, documentation, and error messages serve both people and AI agents.</span></p> </li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>Customer and data authority:</strong> Connect with customers regularly, serve as an internal advocate for their needs, and define metrics that demonstrate value for users and the business.</span></p> </li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>Influence across teams:</strong> Build alignment across engineering, design, Product Marketing, support, and leadership.</span></p> </li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>Go-to-market:</strong> Partner with Product Marketing early so go-to-market strategy helps shape the product, not just the launch.</span></p> </li> </ul> <h1><span style="font-size: 14pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><strong>What you bring</strong></span></h1> <ul> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>Product management experience:</strong> Proven experience in product management owning a distinct product area, ideally focused on developer platforms, PaaS, or cloud infrastructure.</span></p> </li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>Technical depth:</strong> Understanding of building, deploying, and running applications in the cloud, with the ability to collaborate closely with infrastructure engineers on multi-tenant architectures or distributed systems.</span></p> </li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>Software development background:</strong> Familiarity with building software using languages such as Python, Ruby, JavaScript, PHP, Go, or Rust.</span></p> </li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>CI/CD, containers &amp; APIs:</strong> Hands-on experience or close collaboration with CI/CD workflows, Docker/OCI container technologies, and a clear vision for intuitive API design.</span></p> </li> <li> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>AI fluency:</strong> Daily use of modern AI tools to research, draft, and prototype workflows, paired with a realistic understanding of where current tools and models fall short.</span></p> </li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>Agentic development:</strong> A strong perspective on autonomous agent architecture and how agentic workflows are transforming modern software engineering.</span></p> </li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>Navigating ambiguity:</strong> Comfort with turning unstructured problem spaces into clear strategies and taking thoughtful action even with incomplete information.</span></p> </li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>Collaborative communication:</strong> Clear written and verbal communication skills, with a track record of listening, building consensus, and uniting teams around a shared vision.</span></p> </li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>Data-informed decision making:</strong> Ability to seek out and evaluate data to guide decisions and track success.</span></p> </li> </ul> <h1><span style="font-size: 14pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><strong>Bonus points for</strong></span></h1> <ul> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Enthusiasm for using and testing the platform capabilities you help build.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Experience using Kubernetes, or building self-service platforms on Kubernetes</span></p> </li> </ul> <h1><span style="font-size: 14pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><strong>Where we hire</strong></span></h1> <p><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;">At Upsun, remote work isn't just a trend - it's our foundation. The freedom of remote work with the support of a diverse, global team has been our successful model for over a decade. Our culture celebrates flexibility and collaboration, and while we have team members in over 30 countries around the globe, we are currently focused on hiring for this role in <strong>Germany, Canada, Spain, France, and the UK</strong>. Although we’re unable to provide visa sponsorship at this time, we welcome applications from all qualified candidates who are legally authorized to work in these countries.&nbsp;</span></p> <h1><span style="font-size: 14pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><strong>How we hire</strong></span></h1> <p><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;">We know that a great hire won’t meet every requirement that we’ve outlined. Speechify's text-to-speech reading products include its iOS app, Android App, Mac App, Chrome Extension, and Web App. Google recently named Speechify the Chrome Extension of the Year and Apple named Speechify its 2025 Design Award winner for Inclusivity.  

Today, nearly 200 people around the globe work on Speechify in a 100% distributed setting – Speechify has no office. These include frontend and backend engineers, AI research scientists, and others from Amazon, Microsoft, and Google, leading PhD programs like Stanford, high growth startups like Stripe, Vercel, Bolt, and many founders of their own companies

What You'll Do
  • Lead the design, architecture, and development of native Windows desktop applications using Windows App SDK, WinUI (or related UI frameworks), C#, XAML, and — when needed — C++.
  • Define and enforce best-practices for Windows desktop development across the codebase: code architecture, performance, memory usage, responsive UI, cross-version compatibility (Windows 10/11+), and maintainability.
  • Drive accessibility efforts: integrate and validate support for accessibility APIs (e.g. Microsoft UI Automation or other relevant Windows accessibility frameworks), ensure UI controls, focus management, keyboard navigation, screen-reader support, and usability for users with disabilities.
  • Collaborate closely with product designers, UX researchers, QA, and other stakeholders to shape feature planning, UI/UX architecture, and long-term roadmap for the Windows platform.
  • Take ownership of full lifecycle of features: conception → design → implementation → testing → release → maintenance. Ensure quality, reliability, and consistency across releases.
  • Identify, diagnose, and resolve complex bugs, performance bottlenecks, memory leaks, rendering issues, or compatibility problems — and propose robust architectural or design solutions.
 
An ideal candidate should have

Required:

  • 3+ in Windows desktop application development using Windows App SDK, WinUI (or similar), C#, XAML — and ideally additional experience with native Windows code (C++, Win32/WinRT/COM).
  • Deep understanding of Windows application architecture, including interop between managed code (.NET) and native code.
  • Proven track record of designing, building, and shipping production-quality desktop applications, with an emphasis on reliability, performance, scalability, and maintainability.
  • Strong experience with accessibility APIs on Windows (e.g. Microsoft UI Automation or similar), and a dedication to building accessible and inclusive software.
  • Excellent software engineering fundamentals: OOP, design patterns, data structures, algorithms, memory management, multi-threading or asynchronous programming (where relevant).
  • Experience leading technical design, mentoring other engineers, conducting code reviews, and making architecture-level decisions.
  • Strong communication skills; ability to articulate tradeoffs, collaborate with cross-functional teams, and drive consensus.
  • A user-centric mindset: focus on building polished, intuitive, and accessible experiences for end users.

Preferred / Bonus:

  • Experience with writing automated tests for UI — unit tests, integration tests, UI automation tests; familiarity with relevant testing frameworks.
  • Experience with performance optimization for desktop apps (memory usage, startup time, rendering performance, high-DPI support, responsiveness under load).
  • Experience with localization/globalization, right-to-left UI support, internationalization, accessibility for multiple regions.
  • Familiarity with telemetry, analytics, crash reporting, logging, and error monitoring in desktop applications.
  • Previous experience in shaping CI/CD workflows, release pipelines, and deployment strategies for desktop applications.
  • Demonstrated ability to take ownership of feature areas or modules and drive them long-term, including maintenance, refactoring, and technical debt management.

What we offer

  • A high-impact role: you will define architecture, shape the future of our Windows product, and directly influence what millions of users see and experience.
  • A collaborative, flat-structure engineering culture — you are not just a coder, but a builder and a decision-maker.
  • Opportunities to lead — mentor others, steer technical direction, and grow into broader technical leadership (e.g. Tech Lead, Architect).
  • Flexibility, autonomy, and responsibility: you define how to solve problems, own features end-to-end, and contribute to long-term product vision.
  • A purpose-driven mission: building software that's reliable, accessible, and user-centered — making a real difference for people.

title: Principal Thermo-Mechanical Engineer- Paris/Grenoble
description: About Us We are building Physics AI for hardware design . Our software platform helps hardware designers and physics simulation engineers explore, analyze, and optimize hardware systems, leveraging cutting-edge AI to deliver ultrafast, accurate physics intelligence within the realities of engineering design workflows. Our first product bridges the gap between the accuracy & determinism of traditional simulation and the speed & scaling of AI, and is redefining how the world’s most advanced semiconductors are designed, verified, built, brought to market and integrated in complex systems. Role Overview As a pivotal leader within our European Forward Deployment team , you will drive the adoption of Vinci’s platform among the region's top engineering organizations. In this strategic role, you will build, mentor, and guide a high-performing team of thermal engineers dedicated to engaging prospective customers and demonstrating our software's transformative value. As trusted technical advisors , you and your team will use deep simulation expertise to help enterprise customers validate and optimize complex, real-world designs . Through these collaborative engagements, you will champion Vinci's value proposition by showing how our platform delivers systemic improvements in thermal performance, product reliability, and time-to-market. Leveraging strong fundamentals in continuum mechanics , you will guide analyses of complex physical phenomena, including linear, geometric and material nonlinearities, and contact interactions. Your team will evaluate critical factors such as warpage, stress evolution, thermal cycling, and reliability across advanced semiconductor devices, electronics packages, and wafer-scale systems. You will work closely with customer engineering teams to understand their technical challenges, provide expert guidance, and clearly articulate Vinci’s capabilities in solving real-world problems. You will also serve as a key feedback channel t o product and engineering teams, translating customer insights into actionable inputs that shape product direction and drive continuous improvement. This is a remote role, with close collaboration with Sales, Product, and Engineering in Palo Alto, CA, USA. The role includes moderate travel , primarily within continental Europe. Some infrequent intercontinental travel may be required for discussions and collaboration with the US team . Responsibilities Build, lead, and scale a high-performing team of thermo-mechanical engineers , setting the technical direction, hiring, mentoring team members, and driving field execution across Europe. Collaborate closely with the sales team to lead technical discussions, scope proof-of-concept (PoC) evaluations, and deliver compelling product demonstrations to prospective enterprise customers. Guide customer engineering teams through the evaluation phase by overseeing simulation setup, running complex test cases, and interpreting results to explicitly prove Vinci’s technical and business value. Own customer enablement through onboarding, deployment pipeline and account expansion , providing senior technical guidance, structured training sessions, and advanced troubleshooting. Provide product guidance and feedback, identify customer pain points and workflow bottlenecks , partnering directly with internal product and engineering teams to transform field feedback into critical new product features. Represent Vinci at major industry conferences and semiconductor events , engaging technically with key prospects and partners through technical presentations and live platform demonstrations. Maintain a strong understanding of competitive technologies, industry trends, and market positioning to communicate Vinci’s differentiators effectively. Qualifications (Minimum Qualifications) Education: Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a closely related technical field. Technical depth: Expert-level mastery of commercial simulation software (Asys, Abaqus, or equivalent), with 15+ years of hands-on experience in thermo-mechanical simulations— either as a practitioner running simulations or as a technical account manager for commercial physics simulation software. Industry Domain: Deep familiarity with semiconductor electronics packaging, advanced packaging technologies (e.g., 2.5D/3D IC), or foundry ecosystems. Customer Engagement: Prior experience in dedicated customer-facing roles, with a strong ability to build trust and manage engineering client relationships. Automation & Scripting: Practical programming experience using Python or C++ to automate workflows or parse simulation data. Leadership Impact: Proven track record of prior managerial or technical leadership experience, with the ability to scale, mentor, and drive execution across engineering teams. Communication: Elite interpersonal and communication skills, with a proven ability to distill complex physics and simulation results into clear, high-impact narratives for both deep technical panels and business-oriented executives. Preferred (Desirable Differentiators) Multiphysics Breadth: Familiarity with thermal solutions management and/or Electrical Signal Integrity and Power Integrity (SI/PI) workflows. Commercial Track Record: Direct experience commercializing technical software—ideally electronic design automation (EDA) or CAE simulation tools—into major semiconductor and electronics enterprises. Go-To-Market Experience: Prior experience explicitly within technical pre-sales, application engineering (FAE), or strategic technical sales environments. Emerging Tech Adjacency: Ability to rapidly adopt and champion next-generation, physics-based workflows and AI-assisted design or simulation tools. Why Join Us Not just use AI; be part of a team actively redefining how next-generation silicon and hardware are architected. Work at the absolute convergence of state-of-the-art AI models, fundamental physics, and high-stakes enterprise Collaborate with world-class engineers and researchers in a fast-moving startup environment.Ingénieur / Ingénieure principal/e en thermomécanique (H/F) — Paris/Grenoble À propos de Vinci Vinci développe une IA fondée sur la physique (Physics AI) pour la conception de systèmes hardware. Notre plateforme donne aux équipes de conception et de simulation des prédictions physiques précises, obtenues en une fraction du temps d'une simulation classique, et qui s'intègrent à leurs outils existants. C'est la première solution à offrir à la fois la rigueur de la simulation traditionnelle et la vitesse de l'IA. Elle transforme la façon dont les semi-conducteurs les plus avancés au monde sont conçus, vérifiés, fabriqués, mis sur le marché et intégrés dans des systèmes complexes. Présentation du poste En tant que membre clé de notre équipe européenne de Forward Deployment, vous jouerez un rôle déterminant dans l'adoption de la plateforme Vinci par les principales organisations d'ingénierie de la région. Dans ce rôle stratégique, vous constituerez, accompagnerez et dirigerez une équipe performante de spécialistes en ingénierie thermique, chargée d'accompagner nos clients et prospects et de démontrer concrètement la valeur de notre logiciel. En tant que référent technique de confiance auprès de nos clients, vous et votre équipe mettrez à profit votre expertise approfondie en simulation pour aider nos clients industriels à valider et optimiser des conceptions complexes dans des conditions représentatives de leurs applications réelles. À travers ces collaborations, vous démontrerez comment la plateforme Vinci permet d'améliorer les performances thermiques et la fiabilité des produits, tout en accélérant les cycles de conception et la mise sur le marché. Grâce à votre solide maîtrise de la mécanique des milieux continus, vous guiderez l'analyse de phénomènes physiques complexes : comportements linéaires, non-linéarités géométriques et matérielles, et interactions de contact. Votre équipe aidera les clients à évaluer des paramètres critiques tels que le warpage, l'évolution des contraintes, le cyclage thermique et la fiabilité, sur des composants semi-conducteurs avancés, des packages électroniques et des systèmes à l'échelle du wafer. Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec les équipes d'ingénierie de nos clients afin de comprendre leurs problématiques techniques, de leur apporter une expertise approfondie et de démontrer clairement comment Vinci peut répondre à leurs cas d'usage concrets. Vous jouerez également un rôle essentiel d'interface entre les clients et nos équipes Product et Engineering, en transformant les retours du terrain en informations exploitables pour orienter la feuille de route produit et contribuer à l'amélioration continue de la plateforme. Ce poste est basé en France et exercé en télétravail, avec une collaboration étroite avec les équipes Sales, Product et Engineering basées à Palo Alto, en Californie. Il implique des déplacements réguliers mais modérés, principalement en Europe continentale, ainsi que des déplacements occasionnels aux États-Unis pour collaborer avec l'équipe américaine. Responsabilités Construire, diriger et développer une équipe performante d'ingénieur/es en thermomécanique, en définissant l'orientation technique, en recrutant et accompagnant les membres de l'équipe, et en pilotant l'exécution sur le terrain à travers l'Europe. Collaborer étroitement avec l'équipe Sales pour diriger les discussions techniques, définir le périmètre des évaluations en proof-of-concept (PoC) et réaliser des démonstrations de produits convaincantes auprès de clients industriels potentiels. Accompagner les équipes d'ingénierie des clients pendant la phase d'évaluation en supervisant la mise en place des simulations, l'exécution de cas de test complexes et l'interprétation des résultats afin de démontrer concrètement la valeur technique et business de Vinci. Piloter l'accompagnement technique des clients, notamment l'onboarding, le déploiement et l'expansion des comptes, en fournissant une expertise technique de haut niveau, des sessions de formation structurées et un support avancé pour la résolution des problèmes. Fournir des orientations et des retours sur le produit, identifier les difficultés rencontrées par les clients et les points de friction dans leurs workflows, et collaborer directement avec les équipes Produit et Engineering internes afin de transformer les retours du terrain en fonctionnalités produit clés. Représenter Vinci lors de grandes conférences industrielles et d'événements dédiés aux semi-conducteurs, en échangeant avec des prospects et partenaires stratégiques à travers des présentations techniques et des démonstrations en direct de la plateforme. Maintenir une excellente compréhension des technologies concurrentes, des tendances du secteur et du positionnement du marché afin de communiquer efficacement les éléments différenciants de Vinci. Qualifications (Qualifications minimales) Formation : Diplôme d'ingénieur ou équivalent (Master, doctorat) en génie mécanique, génie électrique ou dans un domaine technique étroitement lié. Expertise technique : Maîtrise approfondie de logiciels de simulation commerciaux (Ansys, Abaqus ou équivalent), avec plus de 15 ans d'expérience pratique en simulation thermomécanique — que ce soit en réalisant vous-même des simulations ou dans une fonction de Technical Account Manager pour des logiciels commerciaux de simulation physique. Domaine industriel : Solide connaissance des technologies de packaging électronique pour les semi-conducteurs, des technologies de packaging avancé (par exemple, IC 2.5D/3D) ou des écosystèmes de fonderies. Relation client : Expérience préalable dans des fonctions directement orientées client, avec une forte capacité à établir une relation de confiance et à gérer des relations avec des équipes d'ingénierie côté client. Automatisation & scripting : Expérience pratique en programmation avec Python ou C++ pour automatiser des flux de travail ou analyser des données issues de simulations. Leadership : Expérience avérée en management ou en leadership technique, avec la capacité à développer une équipe, accompagner ses membres et piloter l'exécution au sein d'équipes d'ingénierie. Communication : Excellentes compétences interpersonnelles et de communication, avec une capacité démontrée à transformer des résultats complexes de physique et de simulation en messages clairs et à fort impact, aussi bien pour des publics techniques de haut niveau que pour des directions non spécialistes. Profil recherché (Atouts différenciants) Expertise multiphysique : Connaissance de la gestion thermique et des solutions de refroidissement et/ou des flux de travail Signal Integrity et Power Integrity (SI/PI). Expérience commerciale : Expérience directe dans la commercialisation de logiciels techniques — idéalement des outils d'Electronic Design Automation (EDA) ou de simulation CAE — auprès de grandes entreprises des secteurs des semi-conducteurs et de l'électronique. Parcours Go-to-Market : Passage préalable par des fonctions de pré-vente technique, d'ingénierie applicative (FAE) ou de vente technique stratégique. Technologies émergentes : Capacité à adopter rapidement et à promouvoir des flux de travail de nouvelle génération fondés sur la physique, ainsi que des outils de conception ou de simulation assistés par l'IA. Pourquoi nous rejoindre ? Ne vous contentez pas d'utiliser l'IA : rejoignez une équipe qui redéfinit activement la manière dont le silicium et les systèmes hardware de nouvelle génération sont conçus. Travaillez à la convergence de modèles d'IA de pointe, de la physique fondamentale et de projets industriels à forts enjeux. Collaborez avec des équipes d'ingénierie et de recherche de renommée mondiale, dans un environnement de start-up en forte croissance. title: Stage - Data Scientist / Data Analyst (H/F)
description: Il y a vingt ans, les premières sélections Les Composantes voyaient le jour. Une histoire née d’une soif d’indépendance et d’une passion pour le vintage. Une manière instinctive de faire circuler les vêtements, guidée par une attention particulière à ce qui dure. Dans son prolongement, Sézane prend vie en 2013 : la première marque de mode française née en ligne. Puis sont venus enrichir cet univers : Octobre Éditions pour les hommes, Les Composantes, dédiée cette fois à l’art de vivre, et Petit Sézane pour les enfants. Tout s’est construit comme on avance dans la vie : par élans, par gestes spontanés avec cette manière d’apprendre en faisant. Une autre relation au détail, au service et au lien. Une autre manière d’habiller le réel, d’abord en ligne, puis à travers nos Appartements. Nous recherchons aujourd’hui des talents créatifs, structurés et agiles qui partagent l’envie d’améliorer sans cesse tout ce qui peut l’être. Des talents passionnés, autonomes qui conçoivent le travail dans le respect des autres et pour qui rien n'est hors d'atteinte, pour peu qu'on s'en donne les moyens. Envie d’imaginer la suite de cette histoire à nos côtés ? Ecrivez-nous ! Nous recherchons les talents d’un(e) futur(e) Data Scientist / Data Analyst (H/F) pour rejoindre nos équipes à l’occasion d’un stage de 6 mois de fin d’études de M2 à partir de mars 2027. Ce stage est basé à Paris (75).  Intégré(e) au sein du pôle E-commerce et rattaché(e) au Lead Data Science & Analytics, vous accompagnerez l’équipe dans les sujets du quotidien ainsi que dans la construction de projets dédiés. Vous serez amené(e)s à travailler sur les sujets suivants : Data Analyse Vous serez un(e) membre à part entière de l'équipe Data Science & Analytics et participerez activement à son quotidien : Analyses Ad Hoc : Vous mènerez diverses analyses ponctuelles indispensables pour affiner notre compréhension de nos marques, de la performance de nos produits et du comportement de nos client(e)s. Excellence Opérationnelle : Vous contribuerez au développement continu de l'équipe en identifiant les points de friction, en structurant de nouveaux process et en automatisant les tâches récurrentes. Reporting & Communication Métiers: Vous prendrez la responsabilité de plusieurs mises à jour de reportings. Vous serez responsable du maintien de dashboards hebdomadaires, de reportings mensuels, et de l'initiation des communications clés à destination des équipes métiers. Accompagnement Marketing : Vous participerez aux opérations courantes en réalisant des extractions de données ciblées pour nos initiatives marketing. Cela inclut la mise en place de groupes de contrôle rigoureux et la mesure de la performance incrémentale de ces campagnes. Intégration de l'IA : Vous serez amené(e) à utiliser l'IA au quotidien dans vos missions et participerez activement à la définition et au partage des bonnes pratiques quant à son utilisation au sein de l'équipe. Mise en place d’un moteur d'Embeddings Produits (NLP) : Vous serez au cœur du développement d’un socle algorithmique clé : la transformation de descriptions textuelles en représentations vectorielles (embeddings). Ce projet nourrira de multiples initiatives futures. Vous interviendrez sur l'ensemble du cycle de vie du projet : Data Preprocessing : Nettoyage des données textuelles issues du catalogue, normalisation, et préparation des corpus d'entraînement. Modélisation : Benchmark, sélection fine-tuning des modèles appropriés (Sentence-Transformers, LLMs, etc.). Industrialisation : Le stage ne s’arrête pas au prototype expérimental. Vous participerez activement au déploiement du pipeline dans notre environnement de production via Metaflow. Monitoring : Mise en place de l'automatisation pour la mise à jour des vecteurs lors des nouvelles collections et monitoring de la qualité des embeddings dans le temps. Requirements Vous êtes étudiant(e) en dernière année de formation supérieure (BAC+5) avec une spécialité en Data Science / Machine Learning. Une maîtrise suffisante de SQL est essentielle. Des connaissances en Python seront valorisées. Compréhension des algorithmes de Machine Learning et un fort intérêt pour le NLP. Sensible aux problématiques business : vous êtes animé(e) par l’envie de comprendre nos clients, nos produits et nos process pour générer de l'impact.
